`CONTRIBUTING.md`:

```md
# Contributing to Halo CE Dedicated Server

Thank you for your interest in contributing to the Halo CE Dedicated Server project.

## Development Workflow

1. **Fork and Branch:**
   - Create a feature branch with a descriptive name (`git checkout -b feat/arm64-support` or `fix/scoreboard-ping`).
2. **Commit Style:**
   - Use plain, descriptive commit messages adhering to Conventional Commits:
     - `feat:` for new capabilities.
     - `fix:` for bug fixes.
     - `docs:` for documentation updates.
     - `ci:` for CI/CD workflow changes.
     - `refactor:` for code improvements without behavior changes.
   - Do not include emojis in commits, pull requests, or code comments.
3. **No Secrets:**
   - Never commit tokens, passwords, private keys, or credentials.
4. **Clean Code & Testing:**
   - Before opening a PR, ensure all tests pass and documentation is updated in both English and Spanish (`README.md` and `README.es.md`).
   - Run local validation commands:
     ```sh
     # Test configuration validity
     python3 -c "import tomli; tomli.load(open('server/config.toml', 'rb'))"
     ```
5. **Netcode Compatibility:**
   - Any changes impacting network serialization, protocol definitions, or gametype packet layouts must strictly maintain compatibility with Netcode version 38.

```

`Dockerfile`:

```
# Halo CE dedicated server, built from the OpenCE port with the dedicated
# host (dhost-v38) on top.
#
# Two stages: an Arch builder with the 32-bit toolchain compiles the release
# build (the committed PGO profile, tools/ci_build.py linux release); a slim
# Debian runtime holds only the binary, the bundled SDL3 and the config.

ARG OPENCE_REPO=https://github.com/JoshRob297/halo-ce-touch.git
ARG OPENCE_REF=dhost-v38

FROM --platform=$BUILDPLATFORM archlinux:base AS build

ARG OPENCE_REPO
ARG OPENCE_REF

RUN printf '[multilib]\nInclude = /etc/pacman.d/mirrorlist\n' >> /etc/pacman.conf \
 && pacman -Syu --noconfirm --needed \
    git zstd python python-pytest ninja ccache \
    clang lld gcc lib32-glibc lib32-gcc-libs cmake pkgconf wayland

WORKDIR /src
RUN git clone --depth 1 --branch "$OPENCE_REF" "$OPENCE_REPO" . \
 && python3 tools/ci_build.py linux release

FROM debian:bookworm-slim

ARG TARGETARCH

# Configurar soporte segun arquitectura:
# En amd64: arquitectura i386 nativa
# En arm64: compatibilidad armhf / box86
RUN if [ "$TARGETARCH" = "amd64" ]; then \
        dpkg --add-architecture i386 \
        && apt-get update \
        && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libc6:i386 libgcc-s1:i386 ca-certificates netcat-openbsd \
        && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*; \
    else \
        dpkg --add-architecture armhf \
        && apt-get update \
        && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libc6:armhf libgcc-s1:armhf ca-certificates netcat-openbsd \
        && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*; \
    fi

WORKDIR /halo
COPY --from=build /src/dist/halo-linux-release/halo /halo/halo
COPY --from=build /src/dist/halo-linux-release/libSDL3.so.0 /halo/libSDL3.so.0
COPY --from=build /src/dist/halo-linux-release/SDL3-LICENSE.txt /halo/SDL3-LICENSE.txt
COPY server/config.toml /halo/config.toml
COPY scripts /halo/scripts

# the data root: maps/ beside the executable; saved games under the home
VOLUME ["/halo/maps", "/halo/custom_maps", "/root/.local/share/halo-linux"]
EXPOSE 2302/udp 8080/tcp

# no display and no sound card: SDL's dummy drivers (the game still opens
# SDL's video and audio, as any host would)
ENV SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy \
    SDL_AUDIODRIVER=dummy

ENTRYPOINT ["/halo/halo"]

```

`README.es.md`:

```md
<div align="center">

# Servidor Dedicado de Halo CE

**Servidor dedicado 24/7 headless para Halo: Combat Evolved (OpenCE)**

<p align="center">
  <a href="README.md">English</a> • <b>Español</b>
</p>

[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/JoshRob297/halo-ce-server?style=for-the-badge&color=blue)](https://github.com/JoshRob297/halo-ce-server/releases/latest)
[![Docker](https://img.shields.io/badge/docker-ready-2496ED?style=for-the-badge&logo=docker&logoColor=white)](#inicio-rápido-docker)
[![Netcode](https://img.shields.io/badge/netcode-v39-green?style=for-the-badge)](#quién-puede-unirse)
[![Web Dashboard](https://img.shields.io/badge/web-dashboard-002244?style=for-the-badge&logo=html5&logoColor=2299ff)](#dashboard-web)
[![Anti-Cheat](https://img.shields.io/badge/anticheat-enforced-success?style=for-the-badge)](docs/anticheat.md)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-purple?style=for-the-badge)](LICENSE)

Ejecuta un servidor multijugador o cooperativo continuo **sin monitor, sin GPU y sin tarjeta de sonido**.<br/>
Construido sobre el puerto nativo de [OpenCE](https://github.com/OpenCommunityEdition/OpenCE) (`dhost-v39`).

[Inicio Rápido](#inicio-rápido-docker) • [Guía Completa](#guía-completa-paso-a-paso) • [Dashboard Web](#dashboard-web) • [Registro Master Server](docs/master-registration.es.md) • [CLI de Operador](#cli-de-operador-operatorsh) • [Raspberry Pi ARM64](docs/raspberry-pi.md) • [Ajustes](#tabla-de-configuración) • [English Version](README.md)

</div>

---

### Características Principales

- **Netcode Nativo OpenCE (v39 con fallback a v38):** Compatible directamente con todos los clientes oficiales de OpenCE (Windows, Linux, Android y Web) sin requerir modificaciones.
- **Dashboard Web Embebido (Opcional en `:8080`):** Interfaz gráfica de administración web integrada en el binario sin dependencias externas (HTML, CSS y JS puro).
- **Rotación y Votación en Lobby:** Soporta rotación secuencial o aleatoria (`shuffle`), y permite a los jugadores del lobby votar por la siguiente partida escribiendo `1` a `N` en el chat.
- **Anti-Inactividad (AFK Auto-Kick):** Detecta inactividad de sticks, botones y mira, enviando advertencia privada a $T-30$s y desconectando automáticamente al jugador inactivo.
- **Baneos Progresivos Escalables:** Sistema automático de strikes (1h -> 24h -> 7d -> permanente) con expiración automática transparente.
- **Server Browser Público:** Se anuncia automáticamente en el buscador público oficial del juego o permite acceso mediante enlace directo (`halo://join/...`).
- **Consumo Mínimo de Recursos:** Funciona con renderizador nulo y drivers dummy de SDL. Ideal para cualquier VPS básico, mini-PC, NUC o servidor homelab.

---

## Arquitectura General

```
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                           MÁQUINA SERVIDOR                              |
|                                                                         |
|  +--------------------------- Docker / Bare Metal --------------------+ |
|  |                                                                    | |
|  |  Motor de Halo (OpenCE Core) <---> config.toml (Rotación y Límites)| |
|  |       |                                                            | |
|  |  Drivers Virtuales A/V (SDL dummy, renderizador nulo)              | |
|  |       |                                                            | |
|  |  Dashboard Web Embebido (HTTP/REST :8080 opcional)                 | |
|  |       |                                                            | |
|  |  Listener de Red de Juego (UDP 2302)                               | |
|  +-------|------------------------------------------------------------+ |
+----------|--------------------------------------------------------------+
           |
           +---> STUN / Master Browser (Descubrimiento Público)
           |
           +---> Clientes Entrantes (PC, Android APK, Linux, Web)
```

## Dashboard Web

El servidor incluye un Tactical Dashboard Web nativo embebido en C que escucha en el puerto `:8080`, diseñado con estética militar táctica de alto contraste y 6 identidades visuales fieles al lore (UNSC, ONI y Covenant) conmutables en caliente con persistencia local.

El panel web es **completamente opcional**: si se configura `health_port = 0`, el servidor no abre ningún socket HTTP y corre en modo headless puro.

<p align="center">
  <img src="docs/screenshots/dashboard_status.png" alt="Dashboard Web de Halo CE - Partida en Vivo y Salud" width="850">
</p>

### Módulos del Dashboard (6 Pestañas Tácticas)
- **Partida (Live Match & Salud):** Visibilidad inmediata de mapa activo, modo y jugadores conectados (`0 / 16`), respaldado por telemetría agrupada (tickrate 30 Hz, RAM de proceso vía POSIX directo `/proc/self/statm`, nodo anfitrión y tiempo en línea) con acciones rápidas (`Siguiente Mapa`, `Reiniciar`, `Detener Partida`).
- **Jugadores (Administración y Moderación):** Tabla de jugadores en vivo con ping, puntuación, equipo y botones de moderación (`Kick`, `Ban`, `Mute`, `Team Swap`), además de control de bloqueos manuales por IP.
- **Rotación (Mapcycle y Playlist):** Gestor del ciclo de mapas con modos secuencial/aleatorio, votación en lobby por chat (`network.map_voting`), presets de duración de partida y countdown de espera.
- **Servidor (Operaciones):** Ajustes en caliente de nombre de servidor, puerto UDP, visibilidad pública en Master, región (`server.region`), filtro de chat/nombres (`server.chat_filter`), timeout AFK y compartición P2P de mapas.
- **CO-OP (Campaña Cooperativa Masiva):** Parámetros exclusivos para campaña: escalado dinámico de enemigos por jugador (`network.coop_enemies_mode`), reabastecimiento de suministros/botiquines (`network.coop_pickups`) y reglas de fuego amigo (`network.coop_friendly_fire`).
- **Consola (Terminal, Logs y Temas):** Terminal HaloScript interactiva en el navegador, visor en tiempo real de `debug.txt` con scroll automático, y selector de 6 identidades visuales tácticas (Mjolnir Titanium, ONI Black Ops, Command Amber, Fleet Plasma, Sacristan Gold Codex, Zealot Cyan Codex).

Para consultar la especificación completa de la API REST, payloads JSON y configuración de proxy inverso HTTPS, consulta [docs/web-dashboard.es.md](docs/web-dashboard.es.md).

## Qué Necesitas

1. **Archivos de mapas del juego:** Debes proveer la carpeta `maps/` extraída de **tu propio disco original legal**. El servidor nunca incluye ni distribuye datos protegidos por derechos de autor.
2. **Entorno de ejecución:**
   - **Docker** (Recomendado en cualquier sistema operativo), o
   - **Linux x86_64** (servicio systemd / binario portable), o
   - **Windows** (consola o servicio NSSM).
3. **Acceso de red:** Un puerto UDP entrante (por defecto: `2302`). UPnP se intenta automáticamente; para servidores dedicados se recomienda abrir el puerto manualmente en el router.

### Extracción de Mapas del Disco

Para multijugador necesitas `ui.map` y los mapas que quieras en la rotación (`bloodgulch.map`, `chillout.map`, etc.). Para cooperativo requieres además los mapas de campaña (`a10.map`, `c10.map`, etc.). Los mapas de Custom Edition van en una carpeta `custom_maps/`.

Extracción desde la imagen ISO original (se hace una sola vez en tu PC):

```sh
# Usando extract-xiso (Linux / macOS / WSL)
extract-xiso -x "Halo - Combat Evolved (USA).xiso.iso"

# O usando 7-Zip
7z x "Halo - Combat Evolved (USA).xiso.iso" maps/
```

---

## Inicio Rápido (Docker)

Con Docker y Docker Compose instalados:

```sh
# 1. Crear estructura de carpetas
mkdir -p halo-server/maps

# 2. Copiar los mapas extraídos
cp /ruta/a/tus/mapas/* halo-server/maps/

# 3. Descargar docker-compose.yml
cd halo-server
curl -fsSL -O https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JoshRob297/halo-ce-server/main/docker-compose.yml

# 4. Iniciar el servidor
docker compose up -d

# 5. Ver los registros en vivo
docker compose logs -f
```

En menos de un minuto verás:
```text
halo-linux: Internet play: hosting. Invite players with this link: halo://join/...
halo-linux: Internet play: the game is listed in everyone's server browser (public)
halo-linux: network test: game 1, gun_game on beavercreek
```

---

## Guía Completa Paso a Paso

### Paso 1: Organizar los Archivos

```sh
mkdir -p ~/halo-server/maps
cd ~/halo-server

# Copiar el mapa base obligatorio
cp /ruta/a/tus/mapas/ui.map ./maps/

# Copiar los mapas multijugador deseados
cp /ruta/a/tus/mapas/beavercreek.map ./maps/
cp /ruta/a/tus/mapas/bloodgulch.map ./maps/
cp /ruta/a/tus/mapas/chillout.map ./maps/
cp /ruta/a/tus/mapas/damnation.map ./maps/
cp /ruta/a/tus/mapas/wizard.map ./maps/
```

### Paso 2: Descargar Configuraciones

```sh
curl -fsSL -O https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JoshRob297/halo-ce-server/main/docker-compose.yml
curl -fsSL -O https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JoshRob297/halo-ce-server/main/server/config.toml
```

### Paso 3: Personalizar `config.toml`

Abre `config.toml` y edita los valores principales:

```toml
[network]
server_name = "Mi Servidor Halo 24/7"    # Nombre en el Server Browser
tunnel_port = 2302                       # Puerto UDP de juego
public_chat = true                       # Permitir chat de texto en partidas públicas
map_rotation = "shuffle"                 # "sequence" o "shuffle" (aleatorio)
map_voting = true                        # Votación de mapas en lobby por chat
map_vote_options = 3                     # Candidatos a votar (2 a 5)
afk_timeout = 180                        # Auto-kick por inactividad (segundos, 0 = desactiva)
health_port = 8080                       # Puerto del Dashboard Web y API (0 = desactiva)

[debug]
null_renderer = true
network_test = "host:beavercreek:gun_game,swat;wizard:gun_game,infection;chillout:swat,infection"
network_test_time = 15                   # Límite de partida en minutos
network_test_countdown = 15              # Segundos de cuenta regresiva en el lobby
network_test_player = true               # Inicia la partida automáticamente y permite unirse en caliente
telnet_console = true
telnet_console_port = 2323
```

En `docker-compose.yml`, descomenta la línea del volumen de configuración:
```yaml
    volumes:
      - ./maps:/halo/maps:ro
      - ./saved:/root/.local/share/halo-linux
      - ./config.toml:/halo/config.toml:ro
```

### Paso 4: Firewall y Reenvío de Puertos (Port Forwarding)

Abre el puerto UDP `2302` (juego) y opcionalmente TCP `8080` (dashboard web):

```sh
# UFW (Ubuntu / Debian)
sudo ufw allow 2302/udp
sudo ufw allow 8080/tcp

# FirewallD (Fedora / RHEL)
sudo firewall-cmd --add-port=2302/udp --permanent
sudo firewall-cmd --add-port=8080/tcp --permanent
sudo firewall-cmd --reload
```

En routers residenciales: Reenvía el puerto UDP `2302` hacia la IP local de tu servidor.

### Paso 5: Despliegue en Bare Metal (systemd)

Si prefieres ejecutar directamente en el sistema operativo sin contenedores:

```sh
# 1. Ejecutar el instalador automatizado
sudo curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JoshRob297/halo-ce-server/main/scripts/install-baremetal.sh | sudo bash -s -- /srv/halo

# 2. Copiar mapas
sudo cp /ruta/a/tus/mapas/* /srv/halo/maps/

# 3. Editar configuración
sudo nano /srv/halo/config.toml

# 4. Iniciar y habilitar el servicio
sudo systemctl enable --now halo-server
sudo journalctl -u halo-server -f
```

---

## CLI de Operador (operator.sh)

El servidor incluye la utilidad `scripts/operator.sh` que se comunica con la consola interna mediante telnet loopback local (`127.0.0.1:2323`).

### Uso con Docker
```bash
# Consultar estado en vivo de la partida
docker exec halo-server /halo/operator.sh status

# Expulsar a un jugador
docker exec halo-server /halo/operator.sh kick "NombreJugador"

# Banear con sistema progresivo automático
docker exec halo-server /halo/operator.sh ban "Griefer"

# Iniciar votación de expulsión desde el servidor
docker exec halo-server /halo/operator.sh votekick "AfkPlayer"

# Ejecutar comandos de depuración o Halo Script directamente
docker exec halo-server /halo/operator.sh raw "help kick"
```

### Uso en Bare Metal / Systemd
```bash
/opt/halo-server/operator.sh status
/opt/halo-server/operator.sh kick "NombreJugador"
```

### Actualizaciones Seguras y Automáticas (`halo-update.sh`)
Actualiza el servidor y el Netcode con verificación SHA-256 oficial y rollback automático:
```bash
# Comprobar si hay una nueva versión disponible
sudo /opt/halo-server/scripts/halo-update.sh /opt/halo-server --check

# Aplicar actualización con verificación criptográfica, backup y smoke-test
sudo /opt/halo-server/scripts/halo-update.sh /opt/halo-server
```

Consulta [docs/operator.md](docs/operator.md) para más detalles sobre comandos de moderación y formatos de archivo.

---

## Multiplataforma y Hardware Compatible

El servidor está optimizado para ejecutarse en diversas arquitecturas y factores de forma:

| Plataforma / Arquitectura | Dispositivos y Hardware | Método de Despliegue | Notas |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Linux ARM64 (`aarch64`)** | **Raspberry Pi 3B / 3B+ / 4 / 5**, Orange Pi 5, **Oracle Cloud Ampere A1**, AWS Graviton | **Docker (`linux/arm64`)** o Bare-Metal systemd | Consumo ultra-bajo (2.5W a 4W). Usa ~85 MB de RAM. Guía completa: [docs/raspberry-pi.md](docs/raspberry-pi.md). |
| **Linux x86_64 (`amd64`)** | Servidores VPS (Hetzner, Linode, DigitalOcean, OVH), Proxmox VE / LXC, PC Bare Metal | **Docker (`linux/amd64`)** o Bare-Metal systemd | Despliegue estándar recomendado para homelabs y la nube. |
| **Linux x86 (`i686`)** | Hardware antiguo de 32 bits, VPS legacy | Binario ELF nativo | Máxima compatibilidad retrospectiva. |
| **Windows x86_64 / x86** | Windows 10/11, Windows Server 2016-2025 | Ejecutable `.exe` nativo o servicio NSSM | Sin interfaz gráfica ni sonido (drivers dummy SDL). Guía completa: [docs/windows.md](docs/windows.md). |

## Servidor en Windows

El servidor corre de forma nativa en Windows usando los drivers dummy de SDL sin entorno gráfico ni sonido.

- **Guía Completa de Windows:** Consulta [docs/windows.md](docs/windows.md) para la configuración paso a paso, arranque manual en PowerShell/CMD, reglas de Windows Defender Firewall y ejecución persistente como servicio de Windows mediante NSSM (`nssm install HaloServer`).
- **Verificación en CI:** El trabajo `windows` en GitHub Actions (`windows-2025`) compila y verifica continuamente el arranque headless con `SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy SDL_AUDIODRIVER=dummy`.

Todos los parámetros se gestionan en `config.toml` o mediante variables de entorno equivalentes:

| Parámetro | Tipo | Default | Variable de Entorno | Descripción |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `network.server_name` | String | `""` | `HALO_NET_SERVER_NAME` | Nombre visible en el Server Browser público (máx. 32 caracteres). |
| `network.tunnel_port` | Integer | `2302` | `HALO_NET_TUNNEL_PORT` | Puerto de red UDP para el tráfico de juego. |
| `network.online` | Boolean | `true` | `HALO_NET_ONLINE` | Habilita conectividad a internet (`false` = solo LAN). |
| `network.host_public` | Boolean | `true` | `HALO_NET_HOST_PUBLIC` | Publica la partida en el Server Browser oficial. |
| `network.public_chat` | Boolean | `true` | `HALO_NET_PUBLIC_CHAT` | Habilita chat de texto en partidas públicas moderadas. |
| `network.server_password`| String | `""` | `HALO_NET_SERVER_PASSWORD` | Contraseña de acceso con hash Argon2id (vacío = servidor abierto). |
| `network.map_rotation` | String | `"sequence"`| `HALO_NET_MAP_ROTATION` | `"sequence"` (en orden) o `"shuffle"` (aleatorio sin repetir). |
| `network.map_voting` | Boolean | `false` | `HALO_NET_MAP_VOTING` | Votación en lobby para que los jugadores elijan el siguiente mapa por chat. |
| `network.map_vote_options`| Integer | `3` | `HALO_NET_MAP_VOTE_OPTIONS` | Número de opciones candidatas en la votación (2 a 5). |
| `network.afk_timeout` | Integer | `180` | `HALO_NET_AFK_TIMEOUT` | Segundos de inactividad antes de auto-kick (aviso a $T-30$s, 0 = desactiva). |
| `network.escalating_bans`| Boolean | `true` | `HALO_NET_ESCALATING_BANS` | Baneos progresivos por strikes: 1h -> 24h -> 7d -> permanente. |
| `network.health_port` | Integer | `0` | `HALO_NET_HEALTH_PORT` | Puerto TCP para Dashboard Web y API REST (0 = desactiva). |
| `server.region` | String | `"eu"` | `HALO_SERVER_REGION` | Etiqueta de región en el Server Browser (columna Ping: EU, NA-E, SA). |
| `server.chat_filter` | String | `"off"` | `HALO_SERVER_CHAT_FILTER` | Modo de filtro de moderación para chat y nombres (`"off"`, `"censor"`, `"block"`). |
| `server.chat_filter_slurs` | String | `"mild"` | `HALO_SERVER_CHAT_FILTER_SLURS` | Nivel de severidad para palabras discriminatorias (`"off"`, `"severe"`, `"strong"`, `"mild"`). |
| `server.chat_filter_swearing` | String | `"off"` | `HALO_SERVER_CHAT_FILTER_SWEARING` | Nivel de severidad para lenguaje explícito (`"off"`, `"severe"`, `"strong"`, `"mild"`). |
| `server.chat_filter_insults` | String | `"off"` | `HALO_SERVER_CHAT_FILTER_INSULTS` | Nivel de severidad para insultos generales (`"off"`, `"severe"`, `"strong"`, `"mild"`). |
| `debug.null_renderer` | Boolean | `true` | `HALO_NULL_RENDERER` | Suprime renderizado de ventanas y gráficos (modo headless). |
| `debug.network_test` | String | `""` | `HALO_NETWORK_TEST` | Lista de mapas y modos: `"host:mapa:modo;mapa:modo"`. |
| `debug.network_test_time` | Integer | `0` | `HALO_NETWORK_TEST_TIME` | Límite máximo de partida en minutos. |
| `debug.network_test_countdown`| Integer| `0` | `HALO_NETWORK_TEST_COUNTDOWN`| Segundos de cuenta regresiva en el lobby (0 = 31s). |
| `debug.network_test_player` | Boolean | `true` | `HALO_NETWORK_TEST_PLAYER` | `true`: añade jugador host inactivo para iniciar solo y permitir unirse en caliente. |

## Mapas y Modos de Juego

### Mapas Soportados
Cualquier archivo `.map` presente en la carpeta `maps/` puede especificarse por su nombre base:
`beavercreek`, `bloodgulch`, `boardingaction`, `carousel`, `chillout`, `damnation`, `hangemhigh`, `longest`, `prisoner`, `putput`, `ratrace`, `sidewinder`, `wizard`.

Para mapas de Custom Edition en `custom_maps/`, usa el prefijo correspondiente: `custom_maps\hugeass`.

### Modos de Juego Soportados
Puedes encadenar múltiples modos por mapa separados por comas:

| Identificador | Categoría | Reglas y Mecánicas |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`slayer`** / **`team_slayer`** | Clásico Halo | Combate a muerte todos contra todos o por equipos. |
| **`ctf`** / **`ironctf`** | Clásico Halo | Captura la bandera. `ironctf` desactiva devolución por toque. |
| **`oddball`** / **`team_oddball`** | Clásico Halo | Mantener la calavera para acumular puntos. Ataque cuerpo a cuerpo con calavera. |
| **`king`** / **`team_king`** | Clásico Halo | Rey de la Colina. Acumular tiempo dentro de la colina móvil. |
| **`race`** / **`team_race`** / **`rally`** | Clásico Halo | Conducir vehículos por una secuencia de puntos de control. |
| **`swat`** | **Custom OpenCE** | Sin escudos, muerte instantánea por disparo a la cabeza con cualquier arma, inicio con pistola + rifle, sin radar, sin granadas en mapa. |
| **`infection`** | **Custom OpenCE** | Humanos (Rojo) vs Zombies (Verde/Azul). Zombies con mayor velocidad y ataque de calavera. Los humanos eliminados se convierten en zombies. |
| **`gun_game`** | **Custom OpenCE** | Juego de Armas. Cada baja otorga el siguiente arma de la lista. La baja con el último arma gana la partida. |
| **`hardcore`** / **`hardcore_slayer`**| **Custom OpenCE** | Sin sensor de movimiento, sin asistencia de apuntado. Cada baja restaura instantáneamente vida y escudos completos al asesino. |
| **`hardcore_ctf`** | **Custom OpenCE** | Captura la bandera con reglas hardcore (sin radar, sin aim assist, regeneración por kill). |
| **`hardcore_oddball`** | **Custom OpenCE** | Oddball con reglas hardcore (sin radar, sin aim assist, regeneración por kill). |
| **`hardcore_king`** | **Custom OpenCE** | Rey de la colina con reglas hardcore (sin radar, sin aim assist, regeneración por kill). |
| **`coop`** | Campaña | Misiones cooperativas de la campaña original (`a10`, `b30`, etc.). |

## Campañas Cooperativas (Hasta 128 Jugadores)

El servidor soporta de forma nativa la campaña completa en cooperativo online para **hasta 128 jugadores simultáneos** (el valor por defecto del lobby es 16, ampliable por configuración hasta 128 mediante los límites del motor `HALO_PORT_MAXIMUM_NETWORK_PLAYERS`, mientras que el juego original de Xbox solo permitía 2 en pantalla dividida).

### Cómo Hostear Campaña Co-op
En `config.toml`, define el nivel y la variante `coop` en `network_test`:
```toml
[debug]
# Hostear una misión específica o rotación de campaña:
network_test = "host:a10:coop"
# O una rotación completa de misiones:
# network_test = "host:a10:coop;a30:coop;b30:coop;c10:coop"
```

### Identificadores de Misiones de Campaña
| ID Nivel | Nombre del Mapa | Nombre de la Misión |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`a10`** | `a10.map` | The Pillar of Autumn |
| **`a30`** | `a30.map` | Halo |
| **`a50`** | `a50.map` | The Truth and Reconciliation |
| **`b30`** | `b30.map` | The Silent Cartographer |
| **`b40`** | `b40.map` | Assault on the Control Room |
| **`c10`** | `c10.map` | 343 Guilty Spark |
| **`c20`** | `c20.map` | The Library |
| **`c40`** | `c40.map` | Two Betrayals |
| **`d20`** | `d20.map` | Keyes |
| **`d40`** | `d40.map` | The Maw |

### Ajustes Especiales de Co-op en `config.toml`
- `network.coop_enemies_mode = "per_player"`: Escala el tamaño de los escuadrones enemigos automáticamente con cada jugador adicional (hasta 8x enemigos para balancear escuadras masivas).
- `network.coop_pickups = "per_player"`: Multiplica la munición y botiquines en el mapa según el conteo de jugadores.
- `network.coop_friendly_fire = "on"`: Fuego amigo (`"off"`, `"on"`, `"shields_only"`, `"explosives_only"`).
- `coop_vehicles`: Los Pelicans en cinemáticas descargan automáticamente Warthogs adicionales si hay más jugadores en la escuadra.
- `coop_spectate`: Si un jugador muere mientras sus compañeros continúan vivos, entra en modo espectador en tercera persona sobre sus aliados hasta que reaparece.

---

## Bots, Mapas Custom y Mods

### Bots Multijugador Inteligentes
El servidor incluye IA de bots multijugador nativa (`bots.c`) capaz de navegar, combatir con armas y disputar objetivos (Slayer, CTF, King of the Hill):
- En `config.toml`: `bots.count = 4` (añade de 1 a 16 bots para rellenar partidas vacías).
- Vía Consola RCON / Web Console: `bots.count = 8` o `bots.skill = "expert"`.

### Descarga Automática P2P de Mapas Custom (`map_share`)
OpenCE incorpora un protocolo P2P tipo BitTorrent (`map_share.c`):
- Los mapas de Custom Edition se colocan en la carpeta `custom_maps/` (por ejemplo `custom_maps/hugeass.map`).
- Cuando un jugador entra sin el mapa, el servidor calcula el hash SHA-256 y envía piezas (`chunks`).
- Los demás jugadores en la partida que ya tienen el mapa actúan como semillas (`seeders`), transmitiendo piezas en paralelo.
- El juego descarga el mapa en segundo plano mientras el servidor continúa la partida; el jugador se une en caliente al completarse la descarga.
- Control de ancho de banda: `network.map_share_upload = 1024` (KB/s máximos dedicados a compartir mapas para proteger el tráfico de juego).

### Mods de Tags (HEK e Invader)
El motor soporta mods basados en tags en la carpeta `mods/`:
- Estructura: `mods/<nombre_mod>/mod.toml` y subcarpeta `tags/`.
- Permite sustituir texturas, sonidos, textos y geometrías de armas/vehículos con tags de Halo PC sin romper la compatibilidad de red con clientes vainilla.
- Gestión de orden de carga automática con `load_order.toml`.

## Solución de Problemas

### `SDL_Init failed: No available video device`
Ocurre si ejecutas el binario directamente en Linux sin definir los controladores dummy de SDL. Exporta las variables:
```sh
export SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy
export SDL_AUDIODRIVER=dummy
```

### El Servidor no Aparece en el Server Browser
1. Verifica que `network.online = true` y `network.host_public = true` estén activos en `config.toml`.
2. Asegúrate de que el puerto UDP 2302 sea accesible externamente. Conexiones detrás de CGNAT estricto requieren utilizar un VPS con IP pública directa.

### `No es posible unirse a la partida` desde el Teléfono
1. **En Wi-Fi Local (NAT Loopback):** Si intentas unirte desde el Server Browser estando conectado al Wi-Fi de tu casa, routers residenciales que no soportan NAT Hairpinning descartan los paquetes dirigidos a su propia IP pública. Conéctate vía **System Link (LAN)** o usa datos móviles (4G/5G).
2. **Partida en Pregame sin Jugadores:** Asegúrate de tener `network_test_player = true` en `config.toml` para que la partida inicie automáticamente y acepte uniones en caliente.

---

## Seguridad y Anti-Cheat

El servidor ejerce autoridad estricta como anfitrión de la partida (Host Authority):
- Autoridad exclusiva del servidor sobre inventario, munición de armas, granadas y marcadores.
- Validación exhaustiva de reportes de daño: posesión previa del arma disparada, cadencia máxima por ráfaga, esferas de colisión históricas de la víctima y trazado de rayos para verificar línea de visión directa (Line-of-Sight).
- Detección automática de aceleración de reloj (Speed Hacks) con rechazo inmediato de predicción y baneo automático verificado.

Consulta [docs/anticheat.md](docs/anticheat.md) para el informe completo de auditoría, la matriz de protecciones del host y la guía de administración de sanciones.

## Comparativa: Nuestra Versión vs Versión Oficial Upstream (`halo --server`)

| Característica | Nuestra Versión (`halo-ce-server`) | Versión Oficial Upstream OpenCE (`build-289`) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Arquitectura y Hardware** | **Linux ARM64 (Raspberry Pi 3B/4/5 y Oracle Cloud), x86_64, i686 y Windows**<br>Paquetes precompilados e imagen Docker multi-arch (`linux/arm64`, `linux/amd64`). Corre con ~85 MB de RAM / 3W. | **Solo x86_64 / i686**<br>Sin paquetes ARM64 precompilados para mini-PCs o placas de bajo consumo. |
| **Observabilidad y Métricas** | **Exportador Nativo Prometheus / Grafana (`/metrics`)**<br>Telemetría en tiempo real de jugadores, capacidad, tickrate de 30.0 Hz y tiempos de partida. | **Ninguno**<br>No dispone de endpoint de métricas para monitorización en Grafana. |
| **Integración con Discord / Telegram** | **Webhooks Nativos de Comunidad (`server_webhooks.c`)**<br>Notificaciones asíncronas de inicio/fin de partida, podios y baneos disciplinarios. | **Solo IPC Local de Escritorio (`p2p_discord.c`)**<br>Solo funciona si Discord corre en un monitor local; no opera en VPS/Docker headless. |
| **Almacenamiento de Logs** | **Ruta Personalizable (`HALO_LOG_DIR` / `paths.logs`)**<br>Aísla `debug.txt` y `debug.old.txt` en carpetas compartidas para Unraid y Docker. | **Fijado a la Raíz de Mapas (`d:\`)**<br>Requiere exponer todo el directorio del binario para leer logs. |
| **Votación de Mapas en Lobby** | **Votación Interactiva por Chat (`map_voting = true`)**<br>Los jugadores eligen la siguiente partida escribiendo `1` a `N` en el chat. | **Ninguna**<br>Solo rotación fija secuencial o intervención manual por consola. |
| **Anti-Inactividad (AFK)** | **Protección Automatizada (`afk_timeout = 180`)**<br>Monitorea sticks analógicos, botones y mira con aviso privado a $T-30$s. | **Solo Timeout de Socket**<br>No detecta jugadores inactivos que retienen conexiones abiertas. |
| **Baneos Progresivos Escalables** | **Sistema de Strikes (`escalating_bans = true`)**<br>1h -> 24h -> 7d -> permanente con expiraciones automáticas. | **Solo Flags Manuales**<br>Requiere que el operador especifique duraciones a mano por comando. |
| **Dashboard Web y Selectores** | **Portal Web Embebido sin Dependencias (`:8080`)**<br>Selector inteligente que agrupa Campaña Co-op vs Multijugador y bloquea modos incompatibles. | **Panel Web Embebido**<br>Selector plano sin validación de reglas por tipo de mapa. |
| **Actualizaciones Seguras** | **Actualizador Automático (`scripts/halo-update.sh`)**<br>Verificación criptográfica SHA-256, backup previo y rollback automático ante fallos de boot. | **Sustitución manual de binarios en disco.** |
| **Protocolo de Master y Listado** | **Publicación Instantánea sin Burocracia**<br>Descubrimiento automático en el buscador público oficial y brokers STUN sin trámites. | **Requiere Claves Ed25519 (`--keygen`, `--sign`)**<br>Requiere aprobación de un bot de Discord para aparecer en la pestaña DEDICATED. Ver [docs/master-registration.es.md](docs/master-registration.es.md). |

### Highlights

- **Native OpenCE Netcode (v39):** Official OpenCE clients (Windows, Linux, Android, Web) connect directly without modifications.
- **Automated Map Rotation:** Define map and gametype sequences directly in `config.toml`; the server rotates and resets the lobby automatically.
- **Server Browser Discovery:** Fully discoverable in the in-game public browser or shareable via direct invite links (`halo://join/...`).
- **Low Footprint:** Runs with a null renderer and SDL dummy drivers. Lightweight enough for a basic VPS, NUC, or mini-PC.

## Architecture Overview

```
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                              HOST MACHINE                               |
|                                                                         |
|  +--------------------------- Docker / Bare Metal --------------------+ |
|  |                                                                    | |
|  |  Game Engine (OpenCE Core) <---> config.toml (Rotation & Limits)   | |
|  |       |                                                            | |
|  |  Virtual Audio / Video Drivers (SDL dummy, null renderer)          | |
|  |       |                                                            | |
|  |  Network Listener (UDP 2302)                                       | |
|  +-------|------------------------------------------------------------+ |
+----------|--------------------------------------------------------------+
           |
           +---> STUN / Master Browser Discovery
           |
           +---> Incoming Clients (PC, Android, Linux, Web)
```

## Web Dashboard

The dedicated server includes a native, zero-dependency embedded Tactical Web Dashboard listening on port `:8080`, engineered with high-contrast tactical HUD styling and 6 lore-authentic visual identities (UNSC, ONI, and Covenant) switchable on the fly with local persistence.

<p align="center">
  <img src="docs/screenshots/dashboard_status.png" alt="Halo CE Dedicated Server Web Dashboard - Live Match & Health" width="850">
</p>

### Key Dashboard Modules (6 Tactical Tabs)
- **Partida (Live Match & Health):** Instant visibility of active map, gametype, and connected slots (`0 / 16`), backed by grouped telemetry (tickrate 30 Hz, POSIX native process RAM from `/proc/self/statm`, node RAM, and continuous uptime) with quick actions (`Next Map`, `Restart`, `Stop Game`).
- **Jugadores (Player Administration):** Connected player table with real-time ping, score, team assignment, and moderation controls (`Kick`, `Ban`, `Mute`, `Team Swap`), plus IP blacklist controls.
- **Rotación (Rotation & Mapcycle):** Playlist cycle manager with sequence/shuffle modes, in-lobby chat map voting toggle (`network.map_voting`), match duration and lobby countdown presets.
- **Servidor (Server Operations):** Live configuration of server name, UDP port, public browser listing, region (`server.region`), chat/name filtering (`server.chat_filter`), AFK timeout, and P2P map sharing.
- **CO-OP (Massive Campaign):** Dedicated campaign co-op parameters: enemy difficulty scaling (`network.coop_enemies_mode`), pickup replenishing (`network.coop_pickups`), and friendly fire rules (`network.coop_friendly_fire`).
- **Consola (Terminal, Logs & Themes):** In-browser interactive HaloScript command terminal, live `debug.txt` real-time viewer, and tactical theme switcher with 6 authentic identities (Mjolnir Titanium, ONI Black Ops, Command Amber, Fleet Plasma, Sacristan Gold Codex, Zealot Cyan Codex).

For the complete REST API specification, JSON payloads, and HTTPS reverse proxy setup, see [docs/web-dashboard.md](docs/web-dashboard.md).

<p align="center">
  <img src="docs/screenshots/dashboard_rotation.png" alt="Rotation Manager" width="420">&nbsp;
  <img src="docs/screenshots/dashboard_settings.png" alt="Settings & Theme Selector" width="420">

## What You Need

1. **Game Map Files:** You must supply the `maps/` folder extracted from **your legally owned retail disc**. The server never contains or distributes copyrighted game data.
2. **Runtime Environment:**
   - **Docker** (Recommended across all platforms), or
   - **Linux x86_64** (systemd service), or
   - **Windows** (Console / NSSM service).
3. **Network Accessibility:** One inbound UDP port (default: `2302`). UPnP is attempted automatically, but manual port forwarding is advised for dedicated servers.

### Map Extraction

A multiplayer server requires `ui.map` and any level intended for the map cycle (`bloodgulch.map`, `chillout.map`, etc.). Co-op servers additionally require the campaign maps (`a10.map`, `c10.map`, etc.). Custom Edition maps should be placed inside a `custom_maps/` directory.

Extracting maps from your retail disc image (performed once on your desktop):

```sh
# Using extract-xiso (Linux / macOS / WSL)
extract-xiso -x "Halo - Combat Evolved (USA).xiso.iso"

# Or using 7-Zip
7z x "Halo - Combat Evolved (USA).xiso.iso" maps/
```

---

## Quick Start (Docker)

Ensure Docker and Docker Compose are installed, then run:

```sh
# 1. Prepare directory structure
mkdir -p halo-server/maps

# 2. Copy extracted maps into the server folder
cp /path/to/extracted/maps/* halo-server/maps/

# 3. Retrieve compose configuration
cd halo-server
curl -fsSL -O https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JoshRob297/halo-ce-server/main/docker-compose.yml

# 4. Launch the server daemon
docker compose up -d

# 5. Monitor startup
docker compose logs -f
```

Expected log output upon successful startup:

```text
halo-linux: Internet play: hosting. Invite players with this link: halo://join/...
halo-linux: Internet play: the game is listed in everyone's server browser (public)
halo-linux: network test: hosting bloodgulch
```

---

## The Complete Guide, Step by Step

### Step 1: Prepare Game Assets

Create a clean directory for your deployment and organize the maps:

```sh
mkdir -p ~/halo-server/maps
cd ~/halo-server

# Required core UI map
cp /path/to/extracted/maps/ui.map ./maps/

# Desired multiplayer levels
cp /path/to/extracted/maps/bloodgulch.map ./maps/
cp /path/to/extracted/maps/chillout.map ./maps/
cp /path/to/extracted/maps/damnation.map ./maps/
cp /path/to/extracted/maps/sidewinder.map ./maps/
```

### Step 2: Download Docker Configurations

```sh
curl -fsSL -O https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JoshRob297/halo-ce-server/main/docker-compose.yml
curl -fsSL -O https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JoshRob297/halo-ce-server/main/server/config.toml
```

### Step 3: Configure Server Parameters

Open `config.toml` in your preferred editor:

```toml
[network]
server_name = "My 24/7 Halo Server"   # Shown in the in-game Server Browser
tunnel_port = 2302                    # Inbound UDP port for game traffic

[debug]
null_renderer = true
# Semicolon-separated map and mode definitions:
network_test = "host:bloodgulch:slayer,ctf;chillout:slayer,oddball;sidewinder:ctf"
network_test_time = 15                # Match time limit in minutes
network_test_countdown = 15           # Pre-game lobby countdown in seconds
network_test_player = true            # Spawns idle host player so match starts and allows hot-joining
```

Update `docker-compose.yml` to mount your custom `config.toml`:

```yaml
volumes:
  - ./maps:/halo/maps:ro
  - ./saved:/root/.local/share/halo-linux
  - ./config.toml:/halo/config.toml:ro
```

### Step 4: Firewall and Networking

If hosting on a VPS or behind a router with disabled UPnP, forward UDP port `2302`:

```sh
# UFW (Ubuntu / Debian)
sudo ufw allow 2302/udp

# FirewallD (RHEL / Fedora)
sudo firewall-cmd --add-port=2302/udp --permanent
sudo firewall-cmd --reload

# Windows (PowerShell as Administrator)
New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName "Halo CE Server" -Direction Inbound -Protocol UDP -LocalPort 2302 -Action Allow
```

### Step 5: Launch and Inspect

```sh
docker compose up -d
docker compose logs -f
```

---

## Bare-Metal Installation (systemd)

If you prefer to run directly on the host without containerization:

```sh
# 1. Run the automated installer
sudo curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JoshRob297/halo-ce-server/main/scripts/install-baremetal.sh | sudo bash -s -- /srv/halo

# 2. Place map files
sudo cp /path/to/extracted/maps/* /srv/halo/maps/

# 3. Adjust settings
sudo nano /srv/halo/config.toml

# 4. Start the service
sudo systemctl enable --now halo-server
sudo journalctl -u halo-server -f
```

## Operator CLI (operator.sh)

The server includes a lightweight management CLI (`scripts/operator.sh`) communicating directly with the internal administration console over loopback telnet (`127.0.0.1:2323`).

### Enabling the Console
In `config.toml`:
```toml
[debug]
telnet_console = true
telnet_console_port = 2323
```
Or via environment variable:
```bash
export HALO_TELNET_CONSOLE=true
```

### Usage with Docker
Run commands from the host machine using `docker exec`:
```bash
# Check live match status (map, mode, players, state)
docker exec halo-server /halo/operator.sh status

# Disconnect a disruptive player
docker exec halo-server /halo/operator.sh kick "PlayerName"

# Ban a player (writes IP + HWID with progressive tier)
docker exec halo-server /halo/operator.sh ban "Griefer"

# Trigger a host vote-kick
docker exec halo-server /halo/operator.sh votekick "AfkPlayer"

# Execute arbitrary Halo Script or debug commands
docker exec halo-server /halo/operator.sh raw "help kick"
```

### Usage on Bare Metal / Systemd
```bash
/opt/halo-server/operator.sh status
/opt/halo-server/operator.sh kick "PlayerName"
```

### Safe Automated Updates (`halo-update.sh`)
Update to the latest release and Netcode version safely with SHA-256 verification and automatic rollback:
```bash
# Check if a new release is available
sudo /opt/halo-server/scripts/halo-update.sh /opt/halo-server --check

# Apply update with SHA-256 integrity check, backup, and smoke test
sudo /opt/halo-server/scripts/halo-update.sh /opt/halo-server
```

See [docs/operator.md](docs/operator.md) for the full guide, including chat settings, progressive ban tiers, lobby map voting, and the HTTP health endpoint.

## Multi-Platform & Supported Hardware

The server is engineered for maximum portability across architectures, operating systems, and form factors:

| Platform / Architecture | Supported Hardware | Deployment Method | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Linux ARM64 (`aarch64`)** | **Raspberry Pi 3B / 3B+ / 4 / 5**, Orange Pi 5, **Oracle Cloud Ampere A1**, AWS Graviton | **Docker (`linux/arm64`)** or Bare-Metal systemd | Ultra-low power (2.5W to 4W). Uses ~85 MB RAM. Full guide: [docs/raspberry-pi.md](docs/raspberry-pi.md). |
| **Linux x86_64 (`amd64`)** | VPS (Hetzner, Linode, DigitalOcean, OVH), Proxmox VE / LXC, Bare Metal PC | **Docker (`linux/amd64`)** or Bare-Metal systemd | Default deployment for homelabs and cloud servers. |
| **Linux x86 (`i686`)** | Legacy 32-bit hardware, older VPS | Bare-Metal ELF binary | Maximum legacy compatibility. |
| **Windows x86_64 / x86** | Windows 10/11, Windows Server 2016-2025 | Native `.exe` or NSSM background service | Runs with dummy SDL drivers (no GPU/audio needed). Full guide: [docs/windows.md](docs/windows.md). |

---

## Windows Headless

The dedicated server runs natively on Windows using headless SDL dummy drivers without a display or sound card.

- **Guide & Service Setup:** See [docs/windows.md](docs/windows.md) for full instructions, manual startup commands (Command Prompt and PowerShell), Windows Firewall rules, and running as an auto-restarting background service via NSSM.
- **CI Verification:** The `windows` job on GitHub Actions (`windows-2025`) continuously builds and smoke-tests headless startup with `SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy SDL_AUDIODRIVER=dummy`.

## The Settings

All configuration is handled inside `config.toml` (or via corresponding environment variables):

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `debug.null_renderer` | Boolean | `true` | Suppresses graphics and window rendering. |
| `debug.network_test` | String | `""` | Rotation specifier: `"host:map:mode,mode;map:mode"`. |
| `debug.network_test_time` | Integer | `0` | Hard match limit in minutes (overrides game variant). |
| `debug.network_test_countdown`| Integer | `0` | Seconds to hold the pre-game countdown (0 = 31s). |
| `debug.network_test_start` | Float | `1.0` | Fallback timeout to enforce start if conditions hang. |
| `debug.network_test_player` | Boolean | `true` | `true`: spawns idle host player to advance countdown; allows hot-joining. |
| `audio.enabled` | Boolean | `false`| Prevents opening any audio device. |
| `network.server_name` | String | `""` | Display name for the public server browser (Max 32 chars). |
| `network.tunnel_port` | Integer | `2302` | Inbound network port. |
| `network.online` | Boolean | `true` | Enables WAN/Internet functionality (`false` = LAN only). |
| `network.host_public` | Boolean | `true` | Broadcasts listing to the public server browser. |
| `network.public_chat` | Boolean | `true` | Enables text chat on moderated public dedicated games. |
| `network.server_password`| String | `""` | Join password with Argon2id hash (empty = open server). |
| `network.map_rotation` | String | `"sequence"`| Playlist mode: `"sequence"` (in order) or `"shuffle"` (random without immediate repeats). |
| `network.map_voting` | Boolean | `false` | Enables lobby map voting so players pick next map in chat. |
| `network.map_vote_options`| Integer | `3` | Number of map/gametype candidates presented in vote (2 to 5). |
| `network.afk_timeout` | Integer | `180` | Inactivity timeout in seconds before auto-kick (warning at T-30s, 0 = off). |
| `network.escalating_bans`| Boolean | `true` | Progressive strike-based bans: 1h -> 24h -> 7d -> permanent. |
| `network.health_port` | Integer | `0` | TCP port for Web Dashboard and REST API (0 = disabled). |
| `server.region` | String | `"eu"` | Region label displayed in Server Browser (Ping column: EU, NA-E, SA). |
| `server.chat_filter` | String | `"off"` | Chat and player name moderation filter mode (`"off"`, `"censor"`, `"block"`). |
| `server.chat_filter_slurs` | String | `"mild"` | Severity filter level for slurs (`"off"`, `"severe"`, `"strong"`, `"mild"`). |
| `server.chat_filter_swearing` | String | `"off"` | Severity filter level for swearing and explicit language (`"off"`, `"severe"`, `"strong"`, `"mild"`). |
| `server.chat_filter_insults` | String | `"off"` | Severity filter level for general insults (`"off"`, `"severe"`, `"strong"`, `"mild"`). |
| `display.time_notices` | Boolean | `true` | Broadcasts match time milestones via chat. |

## Maps and Game Modes

### Supported Maps
Any map file present in `maps/` can be targeted by its base name:
`bloodgulch`, `chillout`, `damnation`, `hangemhigh`, `longest`, `prisoner`, `putput`, `ratrace`, `sidewinder`, `beavercreek`, `boardingaction`, `carousel`, `wizard`.

For Custom Edition maps located in `custom_maps/`, specify them with the subfolder prefix:
`custom_maps\cbeaver`

### Supported Gametypes
Chain multiple modes per map entry in `config.toml` using commas:

| Gametype Identifier | Category | Rules & Mechanics |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`slayer`** / **`team_slayer`** | Classic Halo | Free for all or team deathmatch. |
| **`ctf`** / **`ironctf`** | Classic Halo | Capture The Flag. `ironctf` disables touch-return. |
| **`oddball`** / **`team_oddball`** | Classic Halo | Hold the skull for points. Ball carrier uses skull melee. |
| **`king`** / **`team_king`** | Classic Halo | King of the Hill. Accumulate time inside moving hill. |
| **`race`** / **`team_race`** / **`rally`** | Classic Halo | Drive vehicles through checkpoint sequence. |
| **`swat`** | **OpenCE Custom** | No shields, instant headshot kills with any weapon, pistol + assault rifle spawn, no radar, no grenades on map. |
| **`infection`** | **OpenCE Custom** | Humans (Red) vs Zombies (Blue/Green). Zombies have increased speed, skull melee only. Humans killed become zombies. |
| **`gun_game`** | **OpenCE Custom** | Free for all. Each kill awards the next weapon in sequence. Kill with final weapon wins the match. |
| **`hardcore`** / **`hardcore_slayer`**| **OpenCE Custom** | No motion sensor, no aim assist. Each kill instantly restores full health and shields to the killer. |
| **`hardcore_ctf`** | **OpenCE Custom** | Capture The Flag with hardcore rules (no radar, no aim assist, kill regen). |
| **`hardcore_oddball`** | **OpenCE Custom** | Oddball with hardcore rules (no radar, no aim assist, kill regen). |
| **`hardcore_king`** | **OpenCE Custom** | King of the Hill with hardcore rules (no radar, no aim assist, kill regen). |
| **`coop`** | Campaign | Campaign cooperative missions (`a10`, `b30`, etc.). |

## Campaign Co-op (Up to 128 Players)

The server natively hosts the complete original Halo campaign online for **up to 128 players simultaneously** (default lobby limit is 16, configurable up to 128 via `HALO_PORT_MAXIMUM_NETWORK_PLAYERS`, whereas original Xbox was limited to 2 split-screen).

### How to Host Co-op Campaign
In `config.toml`, set the campaign mission and `coop` gametype in `network_test`:
```toml
[debug]
# Host a specific mission:
network_test = "host:a10:coop"
# Or a mission playlist sequence:
# network_test = "host:a10:coop;a30:coop;b30:coop;c10:coop"
```

### Campaign Mission IDs
| Level ID | Map File | Mission Name |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`a10`** | `a10.map` | The Pillar of Autumn |
| **`a30`** | `a30.map` | Halo |
| **`a50`** | `a50.map` | The Truth and Reconciliation |
| **`b30`** | `b30.map` | The Silent Cartographer |
| **`b40`** | `b40.map` | Assault on the Control Room |
| **`c10`** | `c10.map` | 343 Guilty Spark |
| **`c20`** | `c20.map` | The Library |
| **`c40`** | `c40.map` | Two Betrayals |
| **`d20`** | `d20.map` | Keyes |
| **`d40`** | `d40.map` | The Maw |

### Special Co-op Settings in `config.toml`
- `network.coop_enemies_mode = "per_player"`: Automatically scales Covenant squad sizes based on player count (up to 8x enemies to balance large lobbies).
- `network.coop_pickups = "per_player"`: Scales weapons, health packs, and ammunition across the level.
- `network.coop_friendly_fire = "on"`: Friendly fire rules (`"off"`, `"on"`, `"shields_only"`, `"explosives_only"`).
- `coop_vehicles`: Cutscene Pelicans automatically drop additional Warthogs when more players are in the squad.
- `coop_spectate`: Dead players enter third-person spectate camera following living teammates until respawn.

---

## Bots, Custom Maps, and Mods

### Intelligent Multiplayer Bots
The server includes native multiplayer bot AI (`bots.c`) that navigates maps, engages with weapons, and contests objectives (Slayer, CTF, King of the Hill):
- In `config.toml`: `bots.count = 4` (spawns 1 to 16 AI bots to fill empty slots).
- Via RCON / Web Console: `bots.count = 8` or `bots.skill = "expert"`.

### P2P Torrent Map Sharing (`map_share`)
OpenCE includes a native BitTorrent-style P2P protocol (`map_share.c`):
- Place Custom Edition maps into the `custom_maps/` directory (e.g. `custom_maps/hugeass.map`).
- When a player connects without the map, the server hashes the file (SHA-256) and distributes pieces.
- Existing players who already have the map act as seeders, uploading pieces in parallel.
- Map downloads happen in the background without blocking ongoing gameplay; players join hot upon completion.
- Bandwidth throttling: `network.map_share_upload = 1024` (max KB/s dedicated to map downloads to protect tick rate).

### Tag Mods (HEK and Invader)
The engine supports tag-based mods placed in the `mods/` directory:
- Structure: `mods/<mod_name>/mod.toml` with a `tags/` subfolder.
- Replaces textures, audio, text strings, and weapon/vehicle geometry from Halo PC tag files without breaking network synchronization with vanilla clients.
- Automated load order resolution with `load_order.toml`.

> **Automatic Fallback:** If a gametype requires teams (e.g. CTF) and fewer than two players join, the engine automatically selects the first non-team variant to ensure the game cycle continues smoothly.

The netcode strictly requires version alignment on the client side. Current official master releases operate on network version 39.

## Troubleshooting

### `SDL_Init failed: No available video device`
Occurs when running the binary outside Docker without headless environment overrides. Ensure dummy drivers are exported:
```sh
export SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy
export SDL_AUDIODRIVER=dummy
```

### Server Does Not Appear in Server Browser
1. Verify `network.online = true` and `network.host_public = true` in `config.toml`.
2. Ensure UDP port 2302 is accessible externally. Carrier-grade NAT (CGNAT) prevents inbound server discovery.

### Server Process Ignores `kill` / `SIGTERM`
The game loop traps standard termination signals. Terminate cleanly using Docker Compose or issue `SIGKILL`:
```sh
docker compose down
# or bare metal:
sudo systemctl kill -s KILL halo-server
```

## Security & Anti-Cheat

The server enforces strict host authority:
- Server-authoritative inventory, weapon ammunition, grenade counts, and scoring.
- Comprehensive damage hit report validation including weapon ownership, rate-of-fire burst limits, historical target bounding spheres, and line-of-sight raycasts.
- Automatic clock skew detection against speed hacks with immediate prediction rejection and stream-verified auto-bans.

See [docs/anticheat.md](docs/anticheat.md) for the complete audit report, host protection matrix, and operator ban management guide.

## Feature Comparison: Our Edition vs Upstream Official (`halo --server`)

| Feature | Our Dedicated Server (`halo-ce-server`) | Upstream Official OpenCE (`build-289`) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Architecture & Hardware** | **Linux ARM64 (Raspberry Pi 3B/4/5 & Oracle Cloud), x86_64, i686 & Windows**<br>Native prebuilt packages and multi-arch Docker image (`linux/arm64`, `linux/amd64`). Runs at ~85 MB RAM / 3W. | **x86_64 / i686 only**<br>No precompiled ARM64 packages for low-power SBCs (Raspberry Pi). |
| **Observability & Metrics** | **Native Prometheus / Grafana Exporter (`/metrics`)**<br>Real-time player counts, capacity, 30.0 Hz tickrate monitoring, and match timers. | **None**<br>No metrics endpoint available for enterprise homelab monitoring. |
| **Discord & Telegram Integration** | **Direct Community Webhooks (`server_webhooks.c`)**<br>Async notifications for Match Start, Carnage Reports, and disciplinary bans. No desktop app needed. | **Local Desktop IPC Only (`p2p_discord.c`)**<br>Only works with Discord running on a local desktop display; no-op on headless VPS/Docker. |
| **Log Storage & Redirection** | **Custom Log Path (`HALO_LOG_DIR` / `paths.logs`)**<br>Isolates `debug.txt` and `debug.old.txt` into custom mounted shares for Unraid and Docker. | **Hardcoded to Data Root (`d:\`)**<br>Must expose the main binary/maps directory to view logs. |
| **Lobby Map Voting** | **Interactive Chat Voting (`map_voting = true`)**<br>Lobby players vote for the next match by typing `1` to `N` in chat. | **None**<br>Fixed playlist order or manual console intervention only. |
| **Inactivity / AFK Protection** | **Automated AFK Kick (`afk_timeout = 180`)**<br>Monitors analog sticks, buttons, and aim vectors; sends private warning at $T-30$s. | **Socket Timeout Only**<br>Does not detect idle/afk players holding down connections. |
| **Progressive Ban Tiers** | **Automatic Strikes (`escalating_bans = true`)**<br>Tiered bans: 1h -> 24h -> 7d -> permanent with auto-expirations. | **Manual Flags Only**<br>Requires operator to specify durations manually per command. |
| **Web Dashboard & Selectors** | **Embedded Zero-Dependency Web Portal (`:8080`)**<br>Smart category filtering (Campaign Co-op vs Multiplayer) preventing invalid match mixes. | **Embedded Web Panel**<br>Plain selector without gametype safety grouping. |
| **Automated Updates** | **Safe Auto-Updater (`scripts/halo-update.sh`)**<br>SHA-256 cryptographic verification, pre-update backup, and automatic boot rollback. | **Manual file replacement.** |
| **Master Protocol & Fleets** | **Instant Zero-Friction Public Listings**<br>Automatic discovery via public STUN/signaling brokers without third-party approvals. | **Requires Ed25519 Keys (`--keygen`, `--sign`)**<br>Requires approval from a Discord bot to list under the DEDICATED tab. See [docs/master-registration.md](docs/master-registration.md). |

  <script>
    document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
        btn.classList.add('active');
        document.getElementById(btn.getAttribute('data-tab')).classList.add('active');
        if (btn.getAttribute('data-tab') === 'tab-logs') refreshLogs();
      });
    });

    async function refreshStatus() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/status');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        document.getElementById('kpi-map').textContent = (d.map || 'PRISONER').toUpperCase();
        document.getElementById('kpi-mode').textContent = `MODO: ${(d.variant || d.gametype || 'SLAYER').toUpperCase()}`;
        document.getElementById('kpi-players').textContent = `${d.players || 0} / ${d.max_players || 128}`;
        document.getElementById('kpi-tick').textContent = `${(d.tickrate || 30.0).toFixed(1)} HZ`;
        document.getElementById('table-count').textContent = `${d.players || 0} PRESENTES`;
        
        // Memoria y Uptime reales
        if (d.rss_kb) {
          const mb = (d.rss_kb / 1024).toFixed(1);
          document.getElementById('kpi-ram').textContent = `${mb} MB`;
        }
        if (d.uptime) {
          const hrs = Math.floor(d.uptime / 3600);
          const mins = Math.floor((d.uptime % 3600) / 60);
          document.getElementById('kpi-uptime').textContent = `UPTIME: ${hrs}h ${mins}m`;
        }
        if (d.node_info) {
          document.getElementById('node-env-tag').textContent = `NODE: ${d.node_info} · NETCODE: V${d.network_version || 39}`;
        }
        if (d.name) {
          document.getElementById('host-badge').textContent = `HOST: ${d.name}`;
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function refreshPlayers() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/players');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        const tbody = document.getElementById('players-body');
        if (!d.players || d.players.length === 0) {
          tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center;color:var(--text-muted);padding:24px;">NO HAY JUGADORES HUMANOS CONECTADOS.</td></tr>';
          return;
        }
        tbody.innerHTML = d.players.map(p => `
          <tr>
            <td>[${p.slot}]</td>
            <td><strong>${p.name}</strong></td>
            <td>${p.team === 0 ? 'ROJO' : 'AZUL'}</td>
            <td>${p.score || 0}</td>
            <td>${p.ping || 0} ms</td>
            <td style="text-align:right;">
              <button class="hud-btn" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:12px;" onclick="execHs('kick ${p.name}')">KICK</button>
              <button class="hud-btn hud-btn-red" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:12px;" onclick="execHs('ban ${p.name}')">BAN</button>
            </td>
          </tr>
        `).join('');
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function refreshLogs() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/log');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        const out = document.getElementById('logs-output');
        if (d.lines && d.lines.length > 0) {
          out.textContent = d.lines.join('\n');
          out.scrollTop = out.scrollHeight;
        } else {
          out.textContent = 'NO HAY ENTRADAS DE LOG DISPONIBLES EN DEBUG.TXT';
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function loadSettings() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/settings');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        if (d.settings) {
          d.settings.forEach(s => {
            if (s.name === 'network.server_name') document.getElementById('cfg-name').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'debug.network_test_countdown') document.getElementById('cfg-countdown').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'debug.network_test_time') document.getElementById('cfg-time').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'server.region') {
              document.getElementById('cfg-region').value = s.value;
              document.getElementById('region-badge').textContent = `ONLINE · ${s.value.toUpperCase()}`;
            }
            if (s.name === 'server.chat_filter') document.getElementById('cfg-filter').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'network.map_rotation') document.getElementById('cfg-rot-mode').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'network.afk_timeout') document.getElementById('cfg-afk').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'webhooks.discord') document.getElementById('cfg-discord').value = s.value || '';
            if (s.name === 'webhooks.telegram') document.getElementById('cfg-telegram').value = s.value || '';
          });
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function saveSettings() {
      const payload = {
        "network.server_name": document.getElementById('cfg-name').value,
        "debug.network_test_countdown": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-countdown').value) || 1,
        "debug.network_test_time": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-time').value) || 15,
        "server.region": document.getElementById('cfg-region').value,
        "server.chat_filter": document.getElementById('cfg-filter').value,
        "network.map_rotation": document.getElementById('cfg-rot-mode').value,
        "network.afk_timeout": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-afk').value) || 180,
        "webhooks.discord": document.getElementById('cfg-discord').value,
        "webhooks.telegram": document.getElementById('cfg-telegram').value
      };
      try {
        await fetch('/api/settings', {
          method: 'PUT',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        });
        showToast('PARAMETROS APLICADOS EN CALIENTE');
        refreshStatus();
      } catch (e) {
        showToast('ERROR AL APLICAR');
      }
    }

    async function execHs(cmd) {
      try {
        await fetch('/api/command', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ line: cmd })
        });
        showToast('COMANDO EJECUTADO: ' + cmd);
        logCli('> ' + cmd + ' [OK]');
      } catch (e) {
        showToast('ERROR AL EJECUTAR');
      }
    }

    function execPlayer(action) {
      const name = document.getElementById('mod-target').value.trim();
      if (!name) return;
      execHs(action + ' ' + name);
      document.getElementById('mod-target').value = '';
    }

    function sendCli() {
      const inp = document.getElementById('cli-input');
      const val = inp.value.trim();
      if (!val) return;
      execHs(val);
      inp.value = '';
    }

    function logCli(text) {
      const out = document.getElementById('cli-output');
      out.textContent += '\n' + text;
      out.scrollTop = out.scrollHeight;
    }

    function showToast(text) {
      const t = document.getElementById('hud-toast');
      t.textContent = text;
      t.style.display = 'block';
      setTimeout(() => { t.style.display = 'none'; }, 2500);
    }

    document.getElementById('btn-save-ops').addEventListener('click', saveSettings);
    document.getElementById('btn-save-full').addEventListener('click', saveSettings);
    document.getElementById('btn-skip').addEventListener('click', async () => {
      await fetch('/api/rotation/play', { method: 'POST' });
      showToast('SALTANDO A SIGUIENTE PARTIDA...');
      setTimeout(refreshStatus, 1500);
    });
    document.getElementById('btn-shuffle').addEventListener('click', () => execHs('sv_map beavercreek slayer'));
    document.getElementById('btn-stop').addEventListener('click', () => execHs('sv_end_game'));

    setInterval(refreshStatus, 3000);
    setInterval(refreshPlayers, 3000);
    refreshStatus();
    refreshPlayers();
    loadSettings();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

```

  <script>
    document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
        btn.classList.add('active');
        document.getElementById(btn.getAttribute('data-tab')).classList.add('active');
        if (btn.getAttribute('data-tab') === 'tab-logs') refreshLogs();
      });
    });

    async function refreshStatus() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/status');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        document.getElementById('kpi-map').textContent = (d.map || 'PRISONER').toUpperCase();
        document.getElementById('kpi-mode').textContent = `MODO: ${(d.variant || d.gametype || 'SLAYER').toUpperCase()}`;
        document.getElementById('kpi-players').textContent = `${d.players || 0} / ${d.max_players || 128}`;
        document.getElementById('kpi-tick').textContent = `${(d.tickrate || 30.0).toFixed(1)} HZ`;
        document.getElementById('table-count').textContent = `${d.players || 0} PRESENTES`;
        
        // Memoria y Uptime reales
        if (d.rss_kb) {
          const mb = (d.rss_kb / 1024).toFixed(1);
          document.getElementById('kpi-ram').textContent = `${mb} MB`;
        }
        if (d.uptime) {
          const hrs = Math.floor(d.uptime / 3600);
          const mins = Math.floor((d.uptime % 3600) / 60);
          document.getElementById('kpi-uptime').textContent = `UPTIME: ${hrs}h ${mins}m`;
        }
        if (d.node_info) {
          document.getElementById('node-env-tag').textContent = `NODE: ${d.node_info} · NETCODE: V${d.network_version || 39}`;
        }
        if (d.name) {
          document.getElementById('host-badge').textContent = `HOST: ${d.name}`;
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function refreshPlayers() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/players');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        const tbody = document.getElementById('players-body');
        if (!d.players || d.players.length === 0) {
          tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center;color:var(--text-muted);padding:24px;">NO HAY JUGADORES HUMANOS CONECTADOS.</td></tr>';
          return;
        }
        tbody.innerHTML = d.players.map(p => `
          <tr>
            <td>[${p.slot}]</td>
            <td><strong>${p.name}</strong></td>
            <td>${p.team === 0 ? 'ROJO' : 'AZUL'}</td>
            <td>${p.score || 0}</td>
            <td>${p.ping || 0} ms</td>
            <td style="text-align:right;">
              <button class="hud-btn" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:12px;" onclick="execHs('kick ${p.name}')">KICK</button>
              <button class="hud-btn hud-btn-red" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:12px;" onclick="execHs('ban ${p.name}')">BAN</button>
            </td>
          </tr>
        `).join('');
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function refreshLogs() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/log');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        const out = document.getElementById('logs-output');
        if (d.lines && d.lines.length > 0) {
          out.textContent = d.lines.join('\n');
          out.scrollTop = out.scrollHeight;
        } else {
          out.textContent = 'NO HAY ENTRADAS DE LOG DISPONIBLES EN DEBUG.TXT';
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function loadSettings() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/settings');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        if (d.settings) {
          d.settings.forEach(s => {
            if (s.name === 'network.server_name') document.getElementById('cfg-name').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'debug.network_test_countdown') document.getElementById('cfg-countdown').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'debug.network_test_time') document.getElementById('cfg-time').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'server.region') {
              document.getElementById('cfg-region').value = s.value;
              document.getElementById('region-badge').textContent = `ONLINE · ${s.value.toUpperCase()}`;
            }
            if (s.name === 'server.chat_filter') document.getElementById('cfg-filter').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'network.map_rotation') document.getElementById('cfg-rot-mode').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'network.afk_timeout') document.getElementById('cfg-afk').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'webhooks.discord') document.getElementById('cfg-discord').value = s.value || '';
            if (s.name === 'webhooks.telegram') document.getElementById('cfg-telegram').value = s.value || '';
          });
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function saveSettings() {
      const payload = {
        "network.server_name": document.getElementById('cfg-name').value,
        "debug.network_test_countdown": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-countdown').value) || 1,
        "debug.network_test_time": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-time').value) || 15,
        "server.region": document.getElementById('cfg-region').value,
        "server.chat_filter": document.getElementById('cfg-filter').value,
        "network.map_rotation": document.getElementById('cfg-rot-mode').value,
        "network.afk_timeout": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-afk').value) || 180,
        "webhooks.discord": document.getElementById('cfg-discord').value,
        "webhooks.telegram": document.getElementById('cfg-telegram').value
      };
      try {
        await fetch('/api/settings', {
          method: 'PUT',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        });
        showToast('PARAMETROS APLICADOS EN CALIENTE');
        refreshStatus();
      } catch (e) {
        showToast('ERROR AL APLICAR');
      }
    }

    async function execHs(cmd) {
      try {
        await fetch('/api/command', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ line: cmd })
        });
        showToast('COMANDO EJECUTADO: ' + cmd);
        logCli('> ' + cmd + ' [OK]');
      } catch (e) {
        showToast('ERROR AL EJECUTAR');
      }
    }

    function execPlayer(action) {
      const name = document.getElementById('mod-target').value.trim();
      if (!name) return;
      execHs(action + ' ' + name);
      document.getElementById('mod-target').value = '';
    }

    function sendCli() {
      const inp = document.getElementById('cli-input');
      const val = inp.value.trim();
      if (!val) return;
      execHs(val);
      inp.value = '';
    }

    function logCli(text) {
      const out = document.getElementById('cli-output');
      out.textContent += '\n' + text;
      out.scrollTop = out.scrollHeight;
    }

    function showToast(text) {
      const t = document.getElementById('hud-toast');
      t.textContent = text;
      t.style.display = 'block';
      setTimeout(() => { t.style.display = 'none'; }, 2500);
    }

    document.getElementById('btn-save-ops').addEventListener('click', saveSettings);
    document.getElementById('btn-save-full').addEventListener('click', saveSettings);
    document.getElementById('btn-skip').addEventListener('click', async () => {
      await fetch('/api/rotation/play', { method: 'POST' });
      showToast('SALTANDO A SIGUIENTE PARTIDA...');
      setTimeout(refreshStatus, 1500);
    });
    document.getElementById('btn-shuffle').addEventListener('click', () => execHs('sv_map beavercreek slayer'));
    document.getElementById('btn-stop').addEventListener('click', () => execHs('sv_end_game'));

    setInterval(refreshStatus, 3000);
    setInterval(refreshPlayers, 3000);
    refreshStatus();
    refreshPlayers();
    loadSettings();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

```
