  <script>
    document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
        btn.classList.add('active');
        document.getElementById(btn.getAttribute('data-tab')).classList.add('active');
        if (btn.getAttribute('data-tab') === 'tab-logs') refreshLogs();
      });
    });

    async function refreshStatus() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/status');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        document.getElementById('kpi-map').textContent = (d.map || 'PRISONER').toUpperCase();
        document.getElementById('kpi-mode').textContent = `MODO: ${(d.variant || d.gametype || 'SLAYER').toUpperCase()}`;
        document.getElementById('kpi-players').textContent = `${d.players || 0} / ${d.max_players || 128}`;
        document.getElementById('kpi-tick').textContent = `${(d.tickrate || 30.0).toFixed(1)} HZ`;
        document.getElementById('table-count').textContent = `${d.players || 0} PRESENTES`;
        
        // Memoria y Uptime reales
        if (d.rss_kb) {
          const mb = (d.rss_kb / 1024).toFixed(1);
          document.getElementById('kpi-ram').textContent = `${mb} MB`;
        }
        if (d.uptime) {
          const hrs = Math.floor(d.uptime / 3600);
          const mins = Math.floor((d.uptime % 3600) / 60);
          document.getElementById('kpi-uptime').textContent = `UPTIME: ${hrs}h ${mins}m`;
        }
        if (d.node_info) {
          document.getElementById('node-env-tag').textContent = `NODE: ${d.node_info} · NETCODE: V${d.network_version || 39}`;
        }
        if (d.name) {
          document.getElementById('host-badge').textContent = `HOST: ${d.name}`;
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function refreshPlayers() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/players');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        const tbody = document.getElementById('players-body');
        if (!d.players || d.players.length === 0) {
          tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center;color:var(--text-muted);padding:24px;">NO HAY JUGADORES HUMANOS CONECTADOS.</td></tr>';
          return;
        }
        tbody.innerHTML = d.players.map(p => `
          <tr>
            <td>[${p.slot}]</td>
            <td><strong>${p.name}</strong></td>
            <td>${p.team === 0 ? 'ROJO' : 'AZUL'}</td>
            <td>${p.score || 0}</td>
            <td>${p.ping || 0} ms</td>
            <td style="text-align:right;">
              <button class="hud-btn" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:12px;" onclick="execHs('kick ${p.name}')">KICK</button>
              <button class="hud-btn hud-btn-red" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:12px;" onclick="execHs('ban ${p.name}')">BAN</button>
            </td>
          </tr>
        `).join('');
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function refreshLogs() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/log');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        const out = document.getElementById('logs-output');
        if (d.lines && d.lines.length > 0) {
          out.textContent = d.lines.join('\n');
          out.scrollTop = out.scrollHeight;
        } else {
          out.textContent = 'NO HAY ENTRADAS DE LOG DISPONIBLES EN DEBUG.TXT';
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function loadSettings() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/settings');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        if (d.settings) {
          d.settings.forEach(s => {
            if (s.name === 'network.server_name') document.getElementById('cfg-name').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'debug.network_test_countdown') document.getElementById('cfg-countdown').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'debug.network_test_time') document.getElementById('cfg-time').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'server.region') {
              document.getElementById('cfg-region').value = s.value;
              document.getElementById('region-badge').textContent = `ONLINE · ${s.value.toUpperCase()}`;
            }
            if (s.name === 'server.chat_filter') document.getElementById('cfg-filter').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'network.map_rotation') document.getElementById('cfg-rot-mode').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'network.afk_timeout') document.getElementById('cfg-afk').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'webhooks.discord') document.getElementById('cfg-discord').value = s.value || '';
            if (s.name === 'webhooks.telegram') document.getElementById('cfg-telegram').value = s.value || '';
          });
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function saveSettings() {
      const payload = {
        "network.server_name": document.getElementById('cfg-name').value,
        "debug.network_test_countdown": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-countdown').value) || 1,
        "debug.network_test_time": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-time').value) || 15,
        "server.region": document.getElementById('cfg-region').value,
        "server.chat_filter": document.getElementById('cfg-filter').value,
        "network.map_rotation": document.getElementById('cfg-rot-mode').value,
        "network.afk_timeout": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-afk').value) || 180,
        "webhooks.discord": document.getElementById('cfg-discord').value,
        "webhooks.telegram": document.getElementById('cfg-telegram').value
      };
      try {
        await fetch('/api/settings', {
          method: 'PUT',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        });
        showToast('PARAMETROS APLICADOS EN CALIENTE');
        refreshStatus();
      } catch (e) {
        showToast('ERROR AL APLICAR');
      }
    }

    async function execHs(cmd) {
      try {
        await fetch('/api/command', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ line: cmd })
        });
        showToast('COMANDO EJECUTADO: ' + cmd);
        logCli('> ' + cmd + ' [OK]');
      } catch (e) {
        showToast('ERROR AL EJECUTAR');
      }
    }

    function execPlayer(action) {
      const name = document.getElementById('mod-target').value.trim();
      if (!name) return;
      execHs(action + ' ' + name);
      document.getElementById('mod-target').value = '';
    }

    function sendCli() {
      const inp = document.getElementById('cli-input');
      const val = inp.value.trim();
      if (!val) return;
      execHs(val);
      inp.value = '';
    }

    function logCli(text) {
      const out = document.getElementById('cli-output');
      out.textContent += '\n' + text;
      out.scrollTop = out.scrollHeight;
    }

    function showToast(text) {
      const t = document.getElementById('hud-toast');
      t.textContent = text;
      t.style.display = 'block';
      setTimeout(() => { t.style.display = 'none'; }, 2500);
    }

    document.getElementById('btn-save-ops').addEventListener('click', saveSettings);
    document.getElementById('btn-save-full').addEventListener('click', saveSettings);
    document.getElementById('btn-skip').addEventListener('click', async () => {
      await fetch('/api/rotation/play', { method: 'POST' });
      showToast('SALTANDO A SIGUIENTE PARTIDA...');
      setTimeout(refreshStatus, 1500);
    });
    document.getElementById('btn-shuffle').addEventListener('click', () => execHs('sv_map beavercreek slayer'));
    document.getElementById('btn-stop').addEventListener('click', () => execHs('sv_end_game'));

    setInterval(refreshStatus, 3000);
    setInterval(refreshPlayers, 3000);
    refreshStatus();
    refreshPlayers();
    loadSettings();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

```

  <script>
    document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
        btn.classList.add('active');
        document.getElementById(btn.getAttribute('data-tab')).classList.add('active');
        if (btn.getAttribute('data-tab') === 'tab-logs') refreshLogs();
      });
    });

    async function refreshStatus() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/status');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        document.getElementById('kpi-map').textContent = (d.map || 'PRISONER').toUpperCase();
        document.getElementById('kpi-mode').textContent = `MODO: ${(d.variant || d.gametype || 'SLAYER').toUpperCase()}`;
        document.getElementById('kpi-players').textContent = `${d.players || 0} / ${d.max_players || 128}`;
        document.getElementById('kpi-tick').textContent = `${(d.tickrate || 30.0).toFixed(1)} HZ`;
        document.getElementById('table-count').textContent = `${d.players || 0} PRESENTES`;
        
        // Memoria y Uptime reales
        if (d.rss_kb) {
          const mb = (d.rss_kb / 1024).toFixed(1);
          document.getElementById('kpi-ram').textContent = `${mb} MB`;
        }
        if (d.uptime) {
          const hrs = Math.floor(d.uptime / 3600);
          const mins = Math.floor((d.uptime % 3600) / 60);
          document.getElementById('kpi-uptime').textContent = `UPTIME: ${hrs}h ${mins}m`;
        }
        if (d.node_info) {
          document.getElementById('node-env-tag').textContent = `NODE: ${d.node_info} · NETCODE: V${d.network_version || 39}`;
        }
        if (d.name) {
          document.getElementById('host-badge').textContent = `HOST: ${d.name}`;
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function refreshPlayers() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/players');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        const tbody = document.getElementById('players-body');
        if (!d.players || d.players.length === 0) {
          tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center;color:var(--text-muted);padding:24px;">NO HAY JUGADORES HUMANOS CONECTADOS.</td></tr>';
          return;
        }
        tbody.innerHTML = d.players.map(p => `
          <tr>
            <td>[${p.slot}]</td>
            <td><strong>${p.name}</strong></td>
            <td>${p.team === 0 ? 'ROJO' : 'AZUL'}</td>
            <td>${p.score || 0}</td>
            <td>${p.ping || 0} ms</td>
            <td style="text-align:right;">
              <button class="hud-btn" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:12px;" onclick="execHs('kick ${p.name}')">KICK</button>
              <button class="hud-btn hud-btn-red" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:12px;" onclick="execHs('ban ${p.name}')">BAN</button>
            </td>
          </tr>
        `).join('');
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function refreshLogs() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/log');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        const out = document.getElementById('logs-output');
        if (d.lines && d.lines.length > 0) {
          out.textContent = d.lines.join('\n');
          out.scrollTop = out.scrollHeight;
        } else {
          out.textContent = 'NO HAY ENTRADAS DE LOG DISPONIBLES EN DEBUG.TXT';
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function loadSettings() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/settings');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        if (d.settings) {
          d.settings.forEach(s => {
            if (s.name === 'network.server_name') document.getElementById('cfg-name').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'debug.network_test_countdown') document.getElementById('cfg-countdown').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'debug.network_test_time') document.getElementById('cfg-time').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'server.region') {
              document.getElementById('cfg-region').value = s.value;
              document.getElementById('region-badge').textContent = `ONLINE · ${s.value.toUpperCase()}`;
            }
            if (s.name === 'server.chat_filter') document.getElementById('cfg-filter').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'network.map_rotation') document.getElementById('cfg-rot-mode').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'network.afk_timeout') document.getElementById('cfg-afk').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'webhooks.discord') document.getElementById('cfg-discord').value = s.value || '';
            if (s.name === 'webhooks.telegram') document.getElementById('cfg-telegram').value = s.value || '';
          });
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function saveSettings() {
      const payload = {
        "network.server_name": document.getElementById('cfg-name').value,
        "debug.network_test_countdown": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-countdown').value) || 1,
        "debug.network_test_time": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-time').value) || 15,
        "server.region": document.getElementById('cfg-region').value,
        "server.chat_filter": document.getElementById('cfg-filter').value,
        "network.map_rotation": document.getElementById('cfg-rot-mode').value,
        "network.afk_timeout": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-afk').value) || 180,
        "webhooks.discord": document.getElementById('cfg-discord').value,
        "webhooks.telegram": document.getElementById('cfg-telegram').value
      };
      try {
        await fetch('/api/settings', {
          method: 'PUT',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        });
        showToast('PARAMETROS APLICADOS EN CALIENTE');
        refreshStatus();
      } catch (e) {
        showToast('ERROR AL APLICAR');
      }
    }

    async function execHs(cmd) {
      try {
        await fetch('/api/command', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ line: cmd })
        });
        showToast('COMANDO EJECUTADO: ' + cmd);
        logCli('> ' + cmd + ' [OK]');
      } catch (e) {
        showToast('ERROR AL EJECUTAR');
      }
    }

    function execPlayer(action) {
      const name = document.getElementById('mod-target').value.trim();
      if (!name) return;
      execHs(action + ' ' + name);
      document.getElementById('mod-target').value = '';
    }

    function sendCli() {
      const inp = document.getElementById('cli-input');
      const val = inp.value.trim();
      if (!val) return;
      execHs(val);
      inp.value = '';
    }

    function logCli(text) {
      const out = document.getElementById('cli-output');
      out.textContent += '\n' + text;
      out.scrollTop = out.scrollHeight;
    }

    function showToast(text) {
      const t = document.getElementById('hud-toast');
      t.textContent = text;
      t.style.display = 'block';
      setTimeout(() => { t.style.display = 'none'; }, 2500);
    }

    document.getElementById('btn-save-ops').addEventListener('click', saveSettings);
    document.getElementById('btn-save-full').addEventListener('click', saveSettings);
    document.getElementById('btn-skip').addEventListener('click', async () => {
      await fetch('/api/rotation/play', { method: 'POST' });
      showToast('SALTANDO A SIGUIENTE PARTIDA...');
      setTimeout(refreshStatus, 1500);
    });
    document.getElementById('btn-shuffle').addEventListener('click', () => execHs('sv_map beavercreek slayer'));
    document.getElementById('btn-stop').addEventListener('click', () => execHs('sv_end_game'));

    setInterval(refreshStatus, 3000);
    setInterval(refreshPlayers, 3000);
    refreshStatus();
    refreshPlayers();
    loadSettings();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

```

  <script>
    document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
        btn.classList.add('active');
        document.getElementById(btn.getAttribute('data-tab')).classList.add('active');
        if (btn.getAttribute('data-tab') === 'tab-logs') refreshLogs();
      });
    });

    async function refreshStatus() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/status');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        document.getElementById('kpi-map').textContent = (d.map || 'PRISONER').toUpperCase();
        document.getElementById('kpi-mode').textContent = `MODO: ${(d.variant || d.gametype || 'SLAYER').toUpperCase()}`;
        document.getElementById('kpi-players').textContent = `${d.players || 0} / ${d.max_players || 128}`;
        document.getElementById('kpi-tick').textContent = `${(d.tickrate || 30.0).toFixed(1)} HZ`;
        document.getElementById('table-count').textContent = `${d.players || 0} PRESENTES`;
        
        // Memoria y Uptime reales
        if (d.rss_kb) {
          const mb = (d.rss_kb / 1024).toFixed(1);
          document.getElementById('kpi-ram').textContent = `${mb} MB`;
        }
        if (d.uptime) {
          const hrs = Math.floor(d.uptime / 3600);
          const mins = Math.floor((d.uptime % 3600) / 60);
          document.getElementById('kpi-uptime').textContent = `UPTIME: ${hrs}h ${mins}m`;
        }
        if (d.node_info) {
          document.getElementById('node-env-tag').textContent = `NODE: ${d.node_info} · NETCODE: V${d.network_version || 39}`;
        }
        if (d.name) {
          document.getElementById('host-badge').textContent = `HOST: ${d.name}`;
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function refreshPlayers() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/players');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        const tbody = document.getElementById('players-body');
        if (!d.players || d.players.length === 0) {
          tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center;color:var(--text-muted);padding:24px;">NO HAY JUGADORES HUMANOS CONECTADOS.</td></tr>';
          return;
        }
        tbody.innerHTML = d.players.map(p => `
          <tr>
            <td>[${p.slot}]</td>
            <td><strong>${p.name}</strong></td>
            <td>${p.team === 0 ? 'ROJO' : 'AZUL'}</td>
            <td>${p.score || 0}</td>
            <td>${p.ping || 0} ms</td>
            <td style="text-align:right;">
              <button class="hud-btn" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:12px;" onclick="execHs('kick ${p.name}')">KICK</button>
              <button class="hud-btn hud-btn-red" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:12px;" onclick="execHs('ban ${p.name}')">BAN</button>
            </td>
          </tr>
        `).join('');
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function refreshLogs() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/log');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        const out = document.getElementById('logs-output');
        if (d.lines && d.lines.length > 0) {
          out.textContent = d.lines.join('\n');
          out.scrollTop = out.scrollHeight;
        } else {
          out.textContent = 'NO HAY ENTRADAS DE LOG DISPONIBLES EN DEBUG.TXT';
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function loadSettings() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/settings');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        if (d.settings) {
          d.settings.forEach(s => {
            if (s.name === 'network.server_name') document.getElementById('cfg-name').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'debug.network_test_countdown') document.getElementById('cfg-countdown').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'debug.network_test_time') document.getElementById('cfg-time').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'server.region') {
              document.getElementById('cfg-region').value = s.value;
              document.getElementById('region-badge').textContent = `ONLINE · ${s.value.toUpperCase()}`;
            }
            if (s.name === 'server.chat_filter') document.getElementById('cfg-filter').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'network.map_rotation') document.getElementById('cfg-rot-mode').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'network.afk_timeout') document.getElementById('cfg-afk').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'webhooks.discord') document.getElementById('cfg-discord').value = s.value || '';
            if (s.name === 'webhooks.telegram') document.getElementById('cfg-telegram').value = s.value || '';
          });
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function saveSettings() {
      const payload = {
        "network.server_name": document.getElementById('cfg-name').value,
        "debug.network_test_countdown": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-countdown').value) || 1,
        "debug.network_test_time": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-time').value) || 15,
        "server.region": document.getElementById('cfg-region').value,
        "server.chat_filter": document.getElementById('cfg-filter').value,
        "network.map_rotation": document.getElementById('cfg-rot-mode').value,
        "network.afk_timeout": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-afk').value) || 180,
        "webhooks.discord": document.getElementById('cfg-discord').value,
        "webhooks.telegram": document.getElementById('cfg-telegram').value
      };
      try {
        await fetch('/api/settings', {
          method: 'PUT',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        });
        showToast('PARAMETROS APLICADOS EN CALIENTE');
        refreshStatus();
      } catch (e) {
        showToast('ERROR AL APLICAR');
      }
    }

    async function execHs(cmd) {
      try {
        await fetch('/api/command', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ line: cmd })
        });
        showToast('COMANDO EJECUTADO: ' + cmd);
        logCli('> ' + cmd + ' [OK]');
      } catch (e) {
        showToast('ERROR AL EJECUTAR');
      }
    }

    function execPlayer(action) {
      const name = document.getElementById('mod-target').value.trim();
      if (!name) return;
      execHs(action + ' ' + name);
      document.getElementById('mod-target').value = '';
    }

    function sendCli() {
      const inp = document.getElementById('cli-input');
      const val = inp.value.trim();
      if (!val) return;
      execHs(val);
      inp.value = '';
    }

    function logCli(text) {
      const out = document.getElementById('cli-output');
      out.textContent += '\n' + text;
      out.scrollTop = out.scrollHeight;
    }

    function showToast(text) {
      const t = document.getElementById('hud-toast');
      t.textContent = text;
      t.style.display = 'block';
      setTimeout(() => { t.style.display = 'none'; }, 2500);
    }

    document.getElementById('btn-save-ops').addEventListener('click', saveSettings);
    document.getElementById('btn-save-full').addEventListener('click', saveSettings);
    document.getElementById('btn-skip').addEventListener('click', async () => {
      await fetch('/api/rotation/play', { method: 'POST' });
      showToast('SALTANDO A SIGUIENTE PARTIDA...');
      setTimeout(refreshStatus, 1500);
    });
    document.getElementById('btn-shuffle').addEventListener('click', () => execHs('sv_map beavercreek slayer'));
    document.getElementById('btn-stop').addEventListener('click', () => execHs('sv_end_game'));

    setInterval(refreshStatus, 3000);
    setInterval(refreshPlayers, 3000);
    refreshStatus();
    refreshPlayers();
    loadSettings();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

```

  <script>
    document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
        btn.classList.add('active');
        document.getElementById(btn.getAttribute('data-tab')).classList.add('active');
        if (btn.getAttribute('data-tab') === 'tab-logs') refreshLogs();
      });
    });

    async function refreshStatus() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/status');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        document.getElementById('kpi-map').textContent = (d.map || 'PRISONER').toUpperCase();
        document.getElementById('kpi-mode').textContent = `MODO: ${(d.variant || d.gametype || 'SLAYER').toUpperCase()}`;
        document.getElementById('kpi-players').textContent = `${d.players || 0} / ${d.max_players || 128}`;
        document.getElementById('kpi-tick').textContent = `${(d.tickrate || 30.0).toFixed(1)} HZ`;
        document.getElementById('table-count').textContent = `${d.players || 0} PRESENTES`;
        
        // Memoria y Uptime reales
        if (d.rss_kb) {
          const mb = (d.rss_kb / 1024).toFixed(1);
          document.getElementById('kpi-ram').textContent = `${mb} MB`;
        }
        if (d.uptime) {
          const hrs = Math.floor(d.uptime / 3600);
          const mins = Math.floor((d.uptime % 3600) / 60);
          document.getElementById('kpi-uptime').textContent = `UPTIME: ${hrs}h ${mins}m`;
        }
        if (d.node_info) {
          document.getElementById('node-env-tag').textContent = `NODE: ${d.node_info} · NETCODE: V${d.network_version || 39}`;
        }
        if (d.name) {
          document.getElementById('host-badge').textContent = `HOST: ${d.name}`;
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function refreshPlayers() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/players');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        const tbody = document.getElementById('players-body');
        if (!d.players || d.players.length === 0) {
          tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center;color:var(--text-muted);padding:24px;">NO HAY JUGADORES HUMANOS CONECTADOS.</td></tr>';
          return;
        }
        tbody.innerHTML = d.players.map(p => `
          <tr>
            <td>[${p.slot}]</td>
            <td><strong>${p.name}</strong></td>
            <td>${p.team === 0 ? 'ROJO' : 'AZUL'}</td>
            <td>${p.score || 0}</td>
            <td>${p.ping || 0} ms</td>
            <td style="text-align:right;">
              <button class="hud-btn" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:12px;" onclick="execHs('kick ${p.name}')">KICK</button>
              <button class="hud-btn hud-btn-red" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:12px;" onclick="execHs('ban ${p.name}')">BAN</button>
            </td>
          </tr>
        `).join('');
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function refreshLogs() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/log');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        const out = document.getElementById('logs-output');
        if (d.lines && d.lines.length > 0) {
          out.textContent = d.lines.join('\n');
          out.scrollTop = out.scrollHeight;
        } else {
          out.textContent = 'NO HAY ENTRADAS DE LOG DISPONIBLES EN DEBUG.TXT';
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function loadSettings() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/settings');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        if (d.settings) {
          d.settings.forEach(s => {
            if (s.name === 'network.server_name') document.getElementById('cfg-name').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'debug.network_test_countdown') document.getElementById('cfg-countdown').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'debug.network_test_time') document.getElementById('cfg-time').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'server.region') {
              document.getElementById('cfg-region').value = s.value;
              document.getElementById('region-badge').textContent = `ONLINE · ${s.value.toUpperCase()}`;
            }
            if (s.name === 'server.chat_filter') document.getElementById('cfg-filter').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'network.map_rotation') document.getElementById('cfg-rot-mode').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'network.afk_timeout') document.getElementById('cfg-afk').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'webhooks.discord') document.getElementById('cfg-discord').value = s.value || '';
            if (s.name === 'webhooks.telegram') document.getElementById('cfg-telegram').value = s.value || '';
          });
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function saveSettings() {
      const payload = {
        "network.server_name": document.getElementById('cfg-name').value,
        "debug.network_test_countdown": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-countdown').value) || 1,
        "debug.network_test_time": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-time').value) || 15,
        "server.region": document.getElementById('cfg-region').value,
        "server.chat_filter": document.getElementById('cfg-filter').value,
        "network.map_rotation": document.getElementById('cfg-rot-mode').value,
        "network.afk_timeout": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-afk').value) || 180,
        "webhooks.discord": document.getElementById('cfg-discord').value,
        "webhooks.telegram": document.getElementById('cfg-telegram').value
      };
      try {
        await fetch('/api/settings', {
          method: 'PUT',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        });
        showToast('PARAMETROS APLICADOS EN CALIENTE');
        refreshStatus();
      } catch (e) {
        showToast('ERROR AL APLICAR');
      }
    }

    async function execHs(cmd) {
      try {
        await fetch('/api/command', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ line: cmd })
        });
        showToast('COMANDO EJECUTADO: ' + cmd);
        logCli('> ' + cmd + ' [OK]');
      } catch (e) {
        showToast('ERROR AL EJECUTAR');
      }
    }

    function execPlayer(action) {
      const name = document.getElementById('mod-target').value.trim();
      if (!name) return;
      execHs(action + ' ' + name);
      document.getElementById('mod-target').value = '';
    }

    function sendCli() {
      const inp = document.getElementById('cli-input');
      const val = inp.value.trim();
      if (!val) return;
      execHs(val);
      inp.value = '';
    }

    function logCli(text) {
      const out = document.getElementById('cli-output');
      out.textContent += '\n' + text;
      out.scrollTop = out.scrollHeight;
    }

    function showToast(text) {
      const t = document.getElementById('hud-toast');
      t.textContent = text;
      t.style.display = 'block';
      setTimeout(() => { t.style.display = 'none'; }, 2500);
    }

    document.getElementById('btn-save-ops').addEventListener('click', saveSettings);
    document.getElementById('btn-save-full').addEventListener('click', saveSettings);
    document.getElementById('btn-skip').addEventListener('click', async () => {
      await fetch('/api/rotation/play', { method: 'POST' });
      showToast('SALTANDO A SIGUIENTE PARTIDA...');
      setTimeout(refreshStatus, 1500);
    });
    document.getElementById('btn-shuffle').addEventListener('click', () => execHs('sv_map beavercreek slayer'));
    document.getElementById('btn-stop').addEventListener('click', () => execHs('sv_end_game'));

    setInterval(refreshStatus, 3000);
    setInterval(refreshPlayers, 3000);
    refreshStatus();
    refreshPlayers();
    loadSettings();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

```

  <script>
    document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
        btn.classList.add('active');
        document.getElementById(btn.getAttribute('data-tab')).classList.add('active');
        if (btn.getAttribute('data-tab') === 'tab-logs') refreshLogs();
      });
    });

    async function refreshStatus() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/status');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        document.getElementById('kpi-map').textContent = (d.map || 'PRISONER').toUpperCase();
        document.getElementById('kpi-mode').textContent = `MODO: ${(d.variant || d.gametype || 'SLAYER').toUpperCase()}`;
        document.getElementById('kpi-players').textContent = `${d.players || 0} / ${d.max_players || 128}`;
        document.getElementById('kpi-tick').textContent = `${(d.tickrate || 30.0).toFixed(1)} HZ`;
        document.getElementById('table-count').textContent = `${d.players || 0} PRESENTES`;
        
        // Memoria y Uptime reales
        if (d.rss_kb) {
          const mb = (d.rss_kb / 1024).toFixed(1);
          document.getElementById('kpi-ram').textContent = `${mb} MB`;
        }
        if (d.uptime) {
          const hrs = Math.floor(d.uptime / 3600);
          const mins = Math.floor((d.uptime % 3600) / 60);
          document.getElementById('kpi-uptime').textContent = `UPTIME: ${hrs}h ${mins}m`;
        }
        if (d.node_info) {
          document.getElementById('node-env-tag').textContent = `NODE: ${d.node_info} · NETCODE: V${d.network_version || 39}`;
        }
        if (d.name) {
          document.getElementById('host-badge').textContent = `HOST: ${d.name}`;
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function refreshPlayers() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/players');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        const tbody = document.getElementById('players-body');
        if (!d.players || d.players.length === 0) {
          tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center;color:var(--text-muted);padding:24px;">NO HAY JUGADORES HUMANOS CONECTADOS.</td></tr>';
          return;
        }
        tbody.innerHTML = d.players.map(p => `
          <tr>
            <td>[${p.slot}]</td>
            <td><strong>${p.name}</strong></td>
            <td>${p.team === 0 ? 'ROJO' : 'AZUL'}</td>
            <td>${p.score || 0}</td>
            <td>${p.ping || 0} ms</td>
            <td style="text-align:right;">
              <button class="hud-btn" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:12px;" onclick="execHs('kick ${p.name}')">KICK</button>
              <button class="hud-btn hud-btn-red" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:12px;" onclick="execHs('ban ${p.name}')">BAN</button>
            </td>
          </tr>
        `).join('');
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function refreshLogs() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/log');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        const out = document.getElementById('logs-output');
        if (d.lines && d.lines.length > 0) {
          out.textContent = d.lines.join('\n');
          out.scrollTop = out.scrollHeight;
        } else {
          out.textContent = 'NO HAY ENTRADAS DE LOG DISPONIBLES EN DEBUG.TXT';
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function loadSettings() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/settings');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        if (d.settings) {
          d.settings.forEach(s => {
            if (s.name === 'network.server_name') document.getElementById('cfg-name').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'debug.network_test_countdown') document.getElementById('cfg-countdown').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'debug.network_test_time') document.getElementById('cfg-time').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'server.region') {
              document.getElementById('cfg-region').value = s.value;
              document.getElementById('region-badge').textContent = `ONLINE · ${s.value.toUpperCase()}`;
            }
            if (s.name === 'server.chat_filter') document.getElementById('cfg-filter').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'network.map_rotation') document.getElementById('cfg-rot-mode').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'network.afk_timeout') document.getElementById('cfg-afk').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'webhooks.discord') document.getElementById('cfg-discord').value = s.value || '';
            if (s.name === 'webhooks.telegram') document.getElementById('cfg-telegram').value = s.value || '';
          });
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function saveSettings() {
      const payload = {
        "network.server_name": document.getElementById('cfg-name').value,
        "debug.network_test_countdown": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-countdown').value) || 1,
        "debug.network_test_time": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-time').value) || 15,
        "server.region": document.getElementById('cfg-region').value,
        "server.chat_filter": document.getElementById('cfg-filter').value,
        "network.map_rotation": document.getElementById('cfg-rot-mode').value,
        "network.afk_timeout": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-afk').value) || 180,
        "webhooks.discord": document.getElementById('cfg-discord').value,
        "webhooks.telegram": document.getElementById('cfg-telegram').value
      };
      try {
        await fetch('/api/settings', {
          method: 'PUT',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        });
        showToast('PARAMETROS APLICADOS EN CALIENTE');
        refreshStatus();
      } catch (e) {
        showToast('ERROR AL APLICAR');
      }
    }

    async function execHs(cmd) {
      try {
        await fetch('/api/command', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ line: cmd })
        });
        showToast('COMANDO EJECUTADO: ' + cmd);
        logCli('> ' + cmd + ' [OK]');
      } catch (e) {
        showToast('ERROR AL EJECUTAR');
      }
    }

    function execPlayer(action) {
      const name = document.getElementById('mod-target').value.trim();
      if (!name) return;
      execHs(action + ' ' + name);
      document.getElementById('mod-target').value = '';
    }

    function sendCli() {
      const inp = document.getElementById('cli-input');
      const val = inp.value.trim();
      if (!val) return;
      execHs(val);
      inp.value = '';
    }

    function logCli(text) {
      const out = document.getElementById('cli-output');
      out.textContent += '\n' + text;
      out.scrollTop = out.scrollHeight;
    }

    function showToast(text) {
      const t = document.getElementById('hud-toast');
      t.textContent = text;
      t.style.display = 'block';
      setTimeout(() => { t.style.display = 'none'; }, 2500);
    }

    document.getElementById('btn-save-ops').addEventListener('click', saveSettings);
    document.getElementById('btn-save-full').addEventListener('click', saveSettings);
    document.getElementById('btn-skip').addEventListener('click', async () => {
      await fetch('/api/rotation/play', { method: 'POST' });
      showToast('SALTANDO A SIGUIENTE PARTIDA...');
      setTimeout(refreshStatus, 1500);
    });
    document.getElementById('btn-shuffle').addEventListener('click', () => execHs('sv_map beavercreek slayer'));
    document.getElementById('btn-stop').addEventListener('click', () => execHs('sv_end_game'));

    setInterval(refreshStatus, 3000);
    setInterval(refreshPlayers, 3000);
    refreshStatus();
    refreshPlayers();
    loadSettings();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

```

  <script>
    document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
        btn.classList.add('active');
        document.getElementById(btn.getAttribute('data-tab')).classList.add('active');
        if (btn.getAttribute('data-tab') === 'tab-logs') refreshLogs();
      });
    });

    async function refreshStatus() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/status');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        document.getElementById('kpi-map').textContent = (d.map || 'PRISONER').toUpperCase();
        document.getElementById('kpi-mode').textContent = `MODO: ${(d.variant || d.gametype || 'SLAYER').toUpperCase()}`;
        document.getElementById('kpi-players').textContent = `${d.players || 0} / ${d.max_players || 128}`;
        document.getElementById('kpi-tick').textContent = `${(d.tickrate || 30.0).toFixed(1)} HZ`;
        document.getElementById('table-count').textContent = `${d.players || 0} PRESENTES`;
        
        // Memoria y Uptime reales
        if (d.rss_kb) {
          const mb = (d.rss_kb / 1024).toFixed(1);
          document.getElementById('kpi-ram').textContent = `${mb} MB`;
        }
        if (d.uptime) {
          const hrs = Math.floor(d.uptime / 3600);
          const mins = Math.floor((d.uptime % 3600) / 60);
          document.getElementById('kpi-uptime').textContent = `UPTIME: ${hrs}h ${mins}m`;
        }
        if (d.node_info) {
          document.getElementById('node-env-tag').textContent = `NODE: ${d.node_info} · NETCODE: V${d.network_version || 39}`;
        }
        if (d.name) {
          document.getElementById('host-badge').textContent = `HOST: ${d.name}`;
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function refreshPlayers() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/players');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        const tbody = document.getElementById('players-body');
        if (!d.players || d.players.length === 0) {
          tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center;color:var(--text-muted);padding:24px;">NO HAY JUGADORES HUMANOS CONECTADOS.</td></tr>';
          return;
        }
        tbody.innerHTML = d.players.map(p => `
          <tr>
            <td>[${p.slot}]</td>
            <td><strong>${p.name}</strong></td>
            <td>${p.team === 0 ? 'ROJO' : 'AZUL'}</td>
            <td>${p.score || 0}</td>
            <td>${p.ping || 0} ms</td>
            <td style="text-align:right;">
              <button class="hud-btn" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:12px;" onclick="execHs('kick ${p.name}')">KICK</button>
              <button class="hud-btn hud-btn-red" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:12px;" onclick="execHs('ban ${p.name}')">BAN</button>
            </td>
          </tr>
        `).join('');
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function refreshLogs() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/log');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        const out = document.getElementById('logs-output');
        if (d.lines && d.lines.length > 0) {
          out.textContent = d.lines.join('\n');
          out.scrollTop = out.scrollHeight;
        } else {
          out.textContent = 'NO HAY ENTRADAS DE LOG DISPONIBLES EN DEBUG.TXT';
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function loadSettings() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/settings');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        if (d.settings) {
          d.settings.forEach(s => {
            if (s.name === 'network.server_name') document.getElementById('cfg-name').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'debug.network_test_countdown') document.getElementById('cfg-countdown').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'debug.network_test_time') document.getElementById('cfg-time').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'server.region') {
              document.getElementById('cfg-region').value = s.value;
              document.getElementById('region-badge').textContent = `ONLINE · ${s.value.toUpperCase()}`;
            }
            if (s.name === 'server.chat_filter') document.getElementById('cfg-filter').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'network.map_rotation') document.getElementById('cfg-rot-mode').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'network.afk_timeout') document.getElementById('cfg-afk').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'webhooks.discord') document.getElementById('cfg-discord').value = s.value || '';
            if (s.name === 'webhooks.telegram') document.getElementById('cfg-telegram').value = s.value || '';
          });
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function saveSettings() {
      const payload = {
        "network.server_name": document.getElementById('cfg-name').value,
        "debug.network_test_countdown": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-countdown').value) || 1,
        "debug.network_test_time": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-time').value) || 15,
        "server.region": document.getElementById('cfg-region').value,
        "server.chat_filter": document.getElementById('cfg-filter').value,
        "network.map_rotation": document.getElementById('cfg-rot-mode').value,
        "network.afk_timeout": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-afk').value) || 180,
        "webhooks.discord": document.getElementById('cfg-discord').value,
        "webhooks.telegram": document.getElementById('cfg-telegram').value
      };
      try {
        await fetch('/api/settings', {
          method: 'PUT',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        });
        showToast('PARAMETROS APLICADOS EN CALIENTE');
        refreshStatus();
      } catch (e) {
        showToast('ERROR AL APLICAR');
      }
    }

    async function execHs(cmd) {
      try {
        await fetch('/api/command', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ line: cmd })
        });
        showToast('COMANDO EJECUTADO: ' + cmd);
        logCli('> ' + cmd + ' [OK]');
      } catch (e) {
        showToast('ERROR AL EJECUTAR');
      }
    }

    function execPlayer(action) {
      const name = document.getElementById('mod-target').value.trim();
      if (!name) return;
      execHs(action + ' ' + name);
      document.getElementById('mod-target').value = '';
    }

    function sendCli() {
      const inp = document.getElementById('cli-input');
      const val = inp.value.trim();
      if (!val) return;
      execHs(val);
      inp.value = '';
    }

    function logCli(text) {
      const out = document.getElementById('cli-output');
      out.textContent += '\n' + text;
      out.scrollTop = out.scrollHeight;
    }

    function showToast(text) {
      const t = document.getElementById('hud-toast');
      t.textContent = text;
      t.style.display = 'block';
      setTimeout(() => { t.style.display = 'none'; }, 2500);
    }

    document.getElementById('btn-save-ops').addEventListener('click', saveSettings);
    document.getElementById('btn-save-full').addEventListener('click', saveSettings);
    document.getElementById('btn-skip').addEventListener('click', async () => {
      await fetch('/api/rotation/play', { method: 'POST' });
      showToast('SALTANDO A SIGUIENTE PARTIDA...');
      setTimeout(refreshStatus, 1500);
    });
    document.getElementById('btn-shuffle').addEventListener('click', () => execHs('sv_map beavercreek slayer'));
    document.getElementById('btn-stop').addEventListener('click', () => execHs('sv_end_game'));

    setInterval(refreshStatus, 3000);
    setInterval(refreshPlayers, 3000);
    refreshStatus();
    refreshPlayers();
    loadSettings();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

```

  <script>
    document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
        btn.classList.add('active');
        document.getElementById(btn.getAttribute('data-tab')).classList.add('active');
        if (btn.getAttribute('data-tab') === 'tab-logs') refreshLogs();
      });
    });

    async function refreshStatus() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/status');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        document.getElementById('kpi-map').textContent = (d.map || 'PRISONER').toUpperCase();
        document.getElementById('kpi-mode').textContent = `MODO: ${(d.variant || d.gametype || 'SLAYER').toUpperCase()}`;
        document.getElementById('kpi-players').textContent = `${d.players || 0} / ${d.max_players || 128}`;
        document.getElementById('kpi-tick').textContent = `${(d.tickrate || 30.0).toFixed(1)} HZ`;
        document.getElementById('table-count').textContent = `${d.players || 0} PRESENTES`;
        
        // Memoria y Uptime reales
        if (d.rss_kb) {
          const mb = (d.rss_kb / 1024).toFixed(1);
          document.getElementById('kpi-ram').textContent = `${mb} MB`;
        }
        if (d.uptime) {
          const hrs = Math.floor(d.uptime / 3600);
          const mins = Math.floor((d.uptime % 3600) / 60);
          document.getElementById('kpi-uptime').textContent = `UPTIME: ${hrs}h ${mins}m`;
        }
        if (d.node_info) {
          document.getElementById('node-env-tag').textContent = `NODE: ${d.node_info} · NETCODE: V${d.network_version || 39}`;
        }
        if (d.name) {
          document.getElementById('host-badge').textContent = `HOST: ${d.name}`;
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function refreshPlayers() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/players');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        const tbody = document.getElementById('players-body');
        if (!d.players || d.players.length === 0) {
          tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center;color:var(--text-muted);padding:24px;">NO HAY JUGADORES HUMANOS CONECTADOS.</td></tr>';
          return;
        }
        tbody.innerHTML = d.players.map(p => `
          <tr>
            <td>[${p.slot}]</td>
            <td><strong>${p.name}</strong></td>
            <td>${p.team === 0 ? 'ROJO' : 'AZUL'}</td>
            <td>${p.score || 0}</td>
            <td>${p.ping || 0} ms</td>
            <td style="text-align:right;">
              <button class="hud-btn" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:12px;" onclick="execHs('kick ${p.name}')">KICK</button>
              <button class="hud-btn hud-btn-red" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:12px;" onclick="execHs('ban ${p.name}')">BAN</button>
            </td>
          </tr>
        `).join('');
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function refreshLogs() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/log');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        const out = document.getElementById('logs-output');
        if (d.lines && d.lines.length > 0) {
          out.textContent = d.lines.join('\n');
          out.scrollTop = out.scrollHeight;
        } else {
          out.textContent = 'NO HAY ENTRADAS DE LOG DISPONIBLES EN DEBUG.TXT';
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function loadSettings() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/settings');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        if (d.settings) {
          d.settings.forEach(s => {
            if (s.name === 'network.server_name') document.getElementById('cfg-name').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'debug.network_test_countdown') document.getElementById('cfg-countdown').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'debug.network_test_time') document.getElementById('cfg-time').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'server.region') {
              document.getElementById('cfg-region').value = s.value;
              document.getElementById('region-badge').textContent = `ONLINE · ${s.value.toUpperCase()}`;
            }
            if (s.name === 'server.chat_filter') document.getElementById('cfg-filter').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'network.map_rotation') document.getElementById('cfg-rot-mode').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'network.afk_timeout') document.getElementById('cfg-afk').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'webhooks.discord') document.getElementById('cfg-discord').value = s.value || '';
            if (s.name === 'webhooks.telegram') document.getElementById('cfg-telegram').value = s.value || '';
          });
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function saveSettings() {
      const payload = {
        "network.server_name": document.getElementById('cfg-name').value,
        "debug.network_test_countdown": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-countdown').value) || 1,
        "debug.network_test_time": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-time').value) || 15,
        "server.region": document.getElementById('cfg-region').value,
        "server.chat_filter": document.getElementById('cfg-filter').value,
        "network.map_rotation": document.getElementById('cfg-rot-mode').value,
        "network.afk_timeout": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-afk').value) || 180,
        "webhooks.discord": document.getElementById('cfg-discord').value,
        "webhooks.telegram": document.getElementById('cfg-telegram').value
      };
      try {
        await fetch('/api/settings', {
          method: 'PUT',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        });
        showToast('PARAMETROS APLICADOS EN CALIENTE');
        refreshStatus();
      } catch (e) {
        showToast('ERROR AL APLICAR');
      }
    }

    async function execHs(cmd) {
      try {
        await fetch('/api/command', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ line: cmd })
        });
        showToast('COMANDO EJECUTADO: ' + cmd);
        logCli('> ' + cmd + ' [OK]');
      } catch (e) {
        showToast('ERROR AL EJECUTAR');
      }
    }

    function execPlayer(action) {
      const name = document.getElementById('mod-target').value.trim();
      if (!name) return;
      execHs(action + ' ' + name);
      document.getElementById('mod-target').value = '';
    }

    function sendCli() {
      const inp = document.getElementById('cli-input');
      const val = inp.value.trim();
      if (!val) return;
      execHs(val);
      inp.value = '';
    }

    function logCli(text) {
      const out = document.getElementById('cli-output');
      out.textContent += '\n' + text;
      out.scrollTop = out.scrollHeight;
    }

    function showToast(text) {
      const t = document.getElementById('hud-toast');
      t.textContent = text;
      t.style.display = 'block';
      setTimeout(() => { t.style.display = 'none'; }, 2500);
    }

    document.getElementById('btn-save-ops').addEventListener('click', saveSettings);
    document.getElementById('btn-save-full').addEventListener('click', saveSettings);
    document.getElementById('btn-skip').addEventListener('click', async () => {
      await fetch('/api/rotation/play', { method: 'POST' });
      showToast('SALTANDO A SIGUIENTE PARTIDA...');
      setTimeout(refreshStatus, 1500);
    });
    document.getElementById('btn-shuffle').addEventListener('click', () => execHs('sv_map beavercreek slayer'));
    document.getElementById('btn-stop').addEventListener('click', () => execHs('sv_end_game'));

    setInterval(refreshStatus, 3000);
    setInterval(refreshPlayers, 3000);
    refreshStatus();
    refreshPlayers();
    loadSettings();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

```

  <script>
    document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
        btn.classList.add('active');
        document.getElementById(btn.getAttribute('data-tab')).classList.add('active');
        if (btn.getAttribute('data-tab') === 'tab-logs') refreshLogs();
      });
    });

    async function refreshStatus() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/status');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        document.getElementById('kpi-map').textContent = (d.map || 'PRISONER').toUpperCase();
        document.getElementById('kpi-mode').textContent = `MODO: ${(d.variant || d.gametype || 'SLAYER').toUpperCase()}`;
        document.getElementById('kpi-players').textContent = `${d.players || 0} / ${d.max_players || 128}`;
        document.getElementById('kpi-tick').textContent = `${(d.tickrate || 30.0).toFixed(1)} HZ`;
        document.getElementById('table-count').textContent = `${d.players || 0} PRESENTES`;
        
        // Memoria y Uptime reales
        if (d.rss_kb) {
          const mb = (d.rss_kb / 1024).toFixed(1);
          document.getElementById('kpi-ram').textContent = `${mb} MB`;
        }
        if (d.uptime) {
          const hrs = Math.floor(d.uptime / 3600);
          const mins = Math.floor((d.uptime % 3600) / 60);
          document.getElementById('kpi-uptime').textContent = `UPTIME: ${hrs}h ${mins}m`;
        }
        if (d.node_info) {
          document.getElementById('node-env-tag').textContent = `NODE: ${d.node_info} · NETCODE: V${d.network_version || 39}`;
        }
        if (d.name) {
          document.getElementById('host-badge').textContent = `HOST: ${d.name}`;
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function refreshPlayers() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/players');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        const tbody = document.getElementById('players-body');
        if (!d.players || d.players.length === 0) {
          tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center;color:var(--text-muted);padding:24px;">NO HAY JUGADORES HUMANOS CONECTADOS.</td></tr>';
          return;
        }
        tbody.innerHTML = d.players.map(p => `
          <tr>
            <td>[${p.slot}]</td>
            <td><strong>${p.name}</strong></td>
            <td>${p.team === 0 ? 'ROJO' : 'AZUL'}</td>
            <td>${p.score || 0}</td>
            <td>${p.ping || 0} ms</td>
            <td style="text-align:right;">
              <button class="hud-btn" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:12px;" onclick="execHs('kick ${p.name}')">KICK</button>
              <button class="hud-btn hud-btn-red" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:12px;" onclick="execHs('ban ${p.name}')">BAN</button>
            </td>
          </tr>
        `).join('');
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function refreshLogs() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/log');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        const out = document.getElementById('logs-output');
        if (d.lines && d.lines.length > 0) {
          out.textContent = d.lines.join('\n');
          out.scrollTop = out.scrollHeight;
        } else {
          out.textContent = 'NO HAY ENTRADAS DE LOG DISPONIBLES EN DEBUG.TXT';
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function loadSettings() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/settings');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        if (d.settings) {
          d.settings.forEach(s => {
            if (s.name === 'network.server_name') document.getElementById('cfg-name').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'debug.network_test_countdown') document.getElementById('cfg-countdown').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'debug.network_test_time') document.getElementById('cfg-time').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'server.region') {
              document.getElementById('cfg-region').value = s.value;
              document.getElementById('region-badge').textContent = `ONLINE · ${s.value.toUpperCase()}`;
            }
            if (s.name === 'server.chat_filter') document.getElementById('cfg-filter').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'network.map_rotation') document.getElementById('cfg-rot-mode').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'network.afk_timeout') document.getElementById('cfg-afk').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'webhooks.discord') document.getElementById('cfg-discord').value = s.value || '';
            if (s.name === 'webhooks.telegram') document.getElementById('cfg-telegram').value = s.value || '';
          });
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function saveSettings() {
      const payload = {
        "network.server_name": document.getElementById('cfg-name').value,
        "debug.network_test_countdown": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-countdown').value) || 1,
        "debug.network_test_time": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-time').value) || 15,
        "server.region": document.getElementById('cfg-region').value,
        "server.chat_filter": document.getElementById('cfg-filter').value,
        "network.map_rotation": document.getElementById('cfg-rot-mode').value,
        "network.afk_timeout": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-afk').value) || 180,
        "webhooks.discord": document.getElementById('cfg-discord').value,
        "webhooks.telegram": document.getElementById('cfg-telegram').value
      };
      try {
        await fetch('/api/settings', {
          method: 'PUT',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        });
        showToast('PARAMETROS APLICADOS EN CALIENTE');
        refreshStatus();
      } catch (e) {
        showToast('ERROR AL APLICAR');
      }
    }

    async function execHs(cmd) {
      try {
        await fetch('/api/command', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ line: cmd })
        });
        showToast('COMANDO EJECUTADO: ' + cmd);
        logCli('> ' + cmd + ' [OK]');
      } catch (e) {
        showToast('ERROR AL EJECUTAR');
      }
    }

    function execPlayer(action) {
      const name = document.getElementById('mod-target').value.trim();
      if (!name) return;
      execHs(action + ' ' + name);
      document.getElementById('mod-target').value = '';
    }

    function sendCli() {
      const inp = document.getElementById('cli-input');
      const val = inp.value.trim();
      if (!val) return;
      execHs(val);
      inp.value = '';
    }

    function logCli(text) {
      const out = document.getElementById('cli-output');
      out.textContent += '\n' + text;
      out.scrollTop = out.scrollHeight;
    }

    function showToast(text) {
      const t = document.getElementById('hud-toast');
      t.textContent = text;
      t.style.display = 'block';
      setTimeout(() => { t.style.display = 'none'; }, 2500);
    }

    document.getElementById('btn-save-ops').addEventListener('click', saveSettings);
    document.getElementById('btn-save-full').addEventListener('click', saveSettings);
    document.getElementById('btn-skip').addEventListener('click', async () => {
      await fetch('/api/rotation/play', { method: 'POST' });
      showToast('SALTANDO A SIGUIENTE PARTIDA...');
      setTimeout(refreshStatus, 1500);
    });
    document.getElementById('btn-shuffle').addEventListener('click', () => execHs('sv_map beavercreek slayer'));
    document.getElementById('btn-stop').addEventListener('click', () => execHs('sv_end_game'));

    setInterval(refreshStatus, 3000);
    setInterval(refreshPlayers, 3000);
    refreshStatus();
    refreshPlayers();
    loadSettings();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

```

          <input class="form-input" id="cfg-telegram" placeholder="https://api.telegram.org/bot...">
        </div>
      </div>
      <button class="hud-btn" id="btn-save-full" style="width: 100%; padding: 12px; margin-top: 8px;">GUARDAR CONFIGURACION INTEGRAL</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- TAB 4: CONSOLA CLI -->
  <div class="tab-content" id="tab-console">
    <div class="hud-box">
      <div class="box-title">CONSOLA DIRECTA (HALO ENGINE SCRIPTING)</div>
      <div class="cli-terminal" id="cli-output">UNSC TACTICAL SHELL INITIALIZED.
TYPE COMMAND (e.g. 'status', 'kick &lt;name&gt;', 'ban &lt;name&gt;', 'sv_end_game', 'say &lt;text&gt;')
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------</div>
      <div style="display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 10px;">
        <input class="form-input" id="cli-input" placeholder="Comando (ej: say Hola Spartan, sv_end_game)..." onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter') sendCli()">
        <button class="hud-btn" onclick="sendCli()">EJECUTAR</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- TAB 5: LOGS EN VIVO -->
  <div class="tab-content" id="tab-logs">
    <div class="hud-box">
      <div class="box-title">
        <span>LOGS DEL SISTEMA EN VIVO (DEBUG.TXT)</span>
        <button class="hud-btn" onclick="refreshLogs()" style="font-size: 13px; padding: 2px 10px;">ACTUALIZAR LOGS</button>
      </div>

  <div class="toast" id="hud-toast">PARAMETROS APLICADOS EN CALIENTE</div>

  <script>
    document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
        btn.classList.add('active');
        document.getElementById(btn.getAttribute('data-tab')).classList.add('active');
        if (btn.getAttribute('data-tab') === 'tab-logs') refreshLogs();
      });
    });

    async function refreshStatus() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/status');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        document.getElementById('kpi-map').textContent = (d.map || 'PRISONER').toUpperCase();
        document.getElementById('kpi-mode').textContent = `MODO: ${(d.variant || d.gametype || 'SLAYER').toUpperCase()}`;
        document.getElementById('kpi-players').textContent = `${d.players || 0} / ${d.max_players || 128}`;
        document.getElementById('kpi-tick').textContent = `${(d.tickrate || 30.0).toFixed(1)} HZ`;
        document.getElementById('table-count').textContent = `${d.players || 0} PRESENTES`;
        
        // Memoria y Uptime reales
        if (d.rss_kb) {
          const mb = (d.rss_kb / 1024).toFixed(1);
          document.getElementById('kpi-ram').textContent = `${mb} MB`;
        }
        if (d.uptime) {
          const hrs = Math.floor(d.uptime / 3600);
          const mins = Math.floor((d.uptime % 3600) / 60);
          document.getElementById('kpi-uptime').textContent = `UPTIME: ${hrs}h ${mins}m`;
        }
        if (d.node_info) {
          document.getElementById('node-env-tag').textContent = `NODE: ${d.node_info} · NETCODE: V${d.network_version || 39}`;
        }
        if (d.name) {
          document.getElementById('host-badge').textContent = `HOST: ${d.name}`;
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function refreshPlayers() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/players');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        const tbody = document.getElementById('players-body');
        if (!d.players || d.players.length === 0) {
          tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center;color:var(--text-muted);padding:24px;">NO HAY JUGADORES HUMANOS CONECTADOS.</td></tr>';
          return;
        }
        tbody.innerHTML = d.players.map(p => `
          <tr>
            <td>[${p.slot}]</td>
            <td><strong>${p.name}</strong></td>
            <td>${p.team === 0 ? 'ROJO' : 'AZUL'}</td>
            <td>${p.score || 0}</td>
            <td>${p.ping || 0} ms</td>
            <td style="text-align:right;">
              <button class="hud-btn" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:12px;" onclick="execHs('kick ${p.name}')">KICK</button>
              <button class="hud-btn hud-btn-red" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:12px;" onclick="execHs('ban ${p.name}')">BAN</button>
            </td>
          </tr>
        `).join('');
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function refreshLogs() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/log');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        const out = document.getElementById('logs-output');
        if (d.lines && d.lines.length > 0) {
          out.textContent = d.lines.join('\n');
          out.scrollTop = out.scrollHeight;
        } else {
          out.textContent = 'NO HAY ENTRADAS DE LOG DISPONIBLES EN DEBUG.TXT';
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function loadSettings() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/settings');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const d = await res.json();
        if (d.settings) {
          d.settings.forEach(s => {
            if (s.name === 'network.server_name') document.getElementById('cfg-name').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'debug.network_test_countdown') document.getElementById('cfg-countdown').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'debug.network_test_time') document.getElementById('cfg-time').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'server.region') {
              document.getElementById('cfg-region').value = s.value;
              document.getElementById('region-badge').textContent = `ONLINE · ${s.value.toUpperCase()}`;
            }
            if (s.name === 'server.chat_filter') document.getElementById('cfg-filter').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'network.map_rotation') document.getElementById('cfg-rot-mode').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'network.afk_timeout') document.getElementById('cfg-afk').value = s.value;
            if (s.name === 'webhooks.discord') document.getElementById('cfg-discord').value = s.value || '';
            if (s.name === 'webhooks.telegram') document.getElementById('cfg-telegram').value = s.value || '';
          });
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function saveSettings() {
      const payload = {
        "network.server_name": document.getElementById('cfg-name').value,
        "debug.network_test_countdown": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-countdown').value) || 1,
        "debug.network_test_time": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-time').value) || 15,
        "server.region": document.getElementById('cfg-region').value,
        "server.chat_filter": document.getElementById('cfg-filter').value,
        "network.map_rotation": document.getElementById('cfg-rot-mode').value,
        "network.afk_timeout": parseInt(document.getElementById('cfg-afk').value) || 180,
        "webhooks.discord": document.getElementById('cfg-discord').value,
        "webhooks.telegram": document.getElementById('cfg-telegram').value
      };
      try {
        await fetch('/api/settings', {
          method: 'PUT',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        });
        showToast('PARAMETROS APLICADOS EN CALIENTE');
        refreshStatus();
      } catch (e) {
        showToast('ERROR AL APLICAR');
      }
    }

    async function execHs(cmd) {
      try {
        await fetch('/api/command', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ line: cmd })
        });
        showToast('COMANDO EJECUTADO: ' + cmd);
        logCli('> ' + cmd + ' [OK]');
      } catch (e) {
        showToast('ERROR AL EJECUTAR');
      }
    }

    function execPlayer(action) {
      const name = document.getElementById('mod-target').value.trim();
      if (!name) return;
      execHs(action + ' ' + name);
      document.getElementById('mod-target').value = '';
    }

    function sendCli() {
      const inp = document.getElementById('cli-input');
      const val = inp.value.trim();
      if (!val) return;
      execHs(val);
      inp.value = '';
    }

    function logCli(text) {
      const out = document.getElementById('cli-output');
      out.textContent += '\n' + text;
      out.scrollTop = out.scrollHeight;
    }

    function showToast(text) {
      const t = document.getElementById('hud-toast');
      t.textContent = text;
      t.style.display = 'block';
      setTimeout(() => { t.style.display = 'none'; }, 2500);
    }

    document.getElementById('btn-save-ops').addEventListener('click', saveSettings);
    document.getElementById('btn-save-full').addEventListener('click', saveSettings);
    document.getElementById('btn-skip').addEventListener('click', async () => {
      await fetch('/api/rotation/play', { method: 'POST' });
      showToast('SALTANDO A SIGUIENTE PARTIDA...');
      setTimeout(refreshStatus, 1500);
    });
    document.getElementById('btn-shuffle').addEventListener('click', () => execHs('sv_map beavercreek slayer'));
    document.getElementById('btn-stop').addEventListener('click', () => execHs('sv_end_game'));

    setInterval(refreshStatus, 3000);
    setInterval(refreshPlayers, 3000);
    refreshStatus();
    refreshPlayers();
    loadSettings();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

```
